＊ 男は　会えたことを
　 よろこんでいるかもしれない。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6548_0.ja: ＊ タマゴを　手に入れた。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6556_0.en: * Well, there was not a man here.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6556_0.ja: ＊ (ここに　男は　いなかった)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6562_0.ja:
ノエルを
おまえから
守ってる！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6567_0.en:
* Getting stronger... how?
* Kris, what are you doing!?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6567_0.ja:
＊ 強く…？　どうやって…？
＊ クリス　キミは
　 なにを　してるんだ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6592_0.ja:
ノーゲーム
ノーライフ

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6593_0.ja:
ゲームとか
興味ない

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6598_0.en: * Kris, I bet you're very good at games, aren't you?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6598_0.ja:
＊ クリスは　ゲームが
　 とっても上手なんだよね？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6605_0.en:
(... That was the most monotone
response I've heard in my life?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6605_0.ja: (…取ってつけたみてーな返しだな)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6608_0.en: * W-wow, Kris! Your passion is amazing!!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6608_0.ja:
＊ そ…そっか…！
　 やる気マンマンだね！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6613_0.en: Think Ahead You Will After I Enslave You
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6613_0.ja:
<!--[ワタシ]ニ　下僕ニサレタラ
気ガ変ワルワ-->

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6616_0.en: * If You Aren't Enthusiastic I Won't Want To Enslave You

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6618_0.ja:
＊ べつに
　 なりたくないですから…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6703_0.ja:
ネズミは
ノエルが好き

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6705_0.ja:
ノエルは
そのコに似てる

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6709_0.en: * Wh-why do those mice keep attacking me?!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6709_0.ja:
＊ …なんで　わたしのほうに
　 ばっかり来るの！？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6710_0.en: * What do I look like, the girl from the Nutcracker?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6710_0.ja:
＊ 「くるみ割り人形」のお話に
　 女の子が　ネズミに襲われる
　 場面が　出てくるけど…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6718_0.en: * H-huh? No way! If that's the case...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6718_0.ja:
＊ え…？　やめてよ！
　 でも　もしホントに
　 そうなら…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6719_0.en: * Get them to just give me a lunchbox instead!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6719_0.ja:
＊ 襲ってくるんじゃなくて
　 おべんとうの　ひとつでも
　 持ってきてほしいよね！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6725_0.en: * (Only Kris would say "unknown", not "I don't know.")
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6725_0.ja:
＊ (「不明」…？
　 「わからない」じゃ
　 なくて…？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6726_0.en: * (... then keep standing there like that.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6726_0.ja:
＊ (…しかも　そう言ったきり
　 黙って立ってる…　ホント
　 クリスって　変わってる…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6728_0.en: * (Are they waiting for me to stop mumbling?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6728_0.ja:
＊ (わたしが　小声で
　 ひとりごと言うの　やめるの
　 待ってるのかな…？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6734_0.en: * Then, Kris... m-maybe you can take your sword...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6734_0.ja:
＊ そ…そうなの？
　 じゃ…じゃあ
　 クリスが　その剣で…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6735_0.en: * And be the hero that protects me from the mice?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6735_0.ja:
＊ わたしを　ネズミから
　 守ってくれる…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6737_0.en: * (Don't just stand there in silence...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6737_0.ja:
＊ (なんで　黙って
　 突っ立ってるの…！？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6756_0.en: * (You put your whole head inside and honked.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6756_0.ja:
＊ (頭を突っ込んで
　 ホーンを鳴らした)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6758_0.en: * Kris!? The hell are you doing!?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6758_0.ja:
＊ クリス！！
　 なにやってんだよ！！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6759_0.en: * Huh? Trying to fit your head inside? Yeah, me t-
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6759_0.ja:
＊ あ？
　 頭を突っ込んでみた？
　 ああ　それならオレも…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6760_0.en: * HEY!! WE DON'T HAVE TIME FOR THIS!!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6760_0.ja:
＊ …って　んなこと
　 やってる場合じゃ
　 ねーだろ！！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6771_0.en: * Don't try to run away, you little...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6771_0.ja:
＊ がーっ！
　 逃げんな　こらっ…！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6787_0.ja: バートリンじゃないバードリー

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6789_0.ja: ジョッキントンの部屋

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6792_0.en: * (The nameplate reads ~1. Peek inside?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6792_0.ja: ＊ (表札に 　 「~1」と 　 書いてある。なかを見る？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6814_0.en: * (... What you saw surprised you. ... sort of.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6814_0.ja:
＊ (なかを見て…
　 ある意味　おどろいた)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6818_0.en: * (It's wallpapered with the pink cat ad from the city. It's animated, too.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6818_0.ja:
＊ (かべ紙には　街に出回っている
　 ピンクのネコの広告が使われている。
　 アニメーションつきだ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6828_0.en: * HAHAHA!! Kris, who's room is THIS!?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6828_0.ja:
＊ ガハハ！！　おい！
　 だれの部屋だよ　これ！？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6830_0.en: * HAHAHA!!! Man, you better hope I never meet him...!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6830_0.ja:
＊ ガーッハッハ！！
　 そいつ　オレと会うことに
　 なったら　災難だな！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6834_0.en: * (You opened the door with your eyes closed. You saw nothing.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6834_0.ja:
＊ (目を閉じて　とびらを開いた。
　 なにも見なかった)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6844_0.en: * (You respected the Gamer's Code. No screen peeking.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6844_0.ja:
＊ (ゲーマー精神に　のっとり
　 対戦相手の画面は
　 のぞき見しないことにした)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6848_0.en: * (You can smell the glittery cat food from here anyway.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6848_0.ja:
＊ (キラキラキャットフードの
　 ニオイが　ここまで
　 ただよってくる)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6852_0.en: * (You feel like Noelle would enjoy this more.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6852_0.ja:
＊ (ノエルならきっと
　 なかを見て　よろこぶだろう)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6856_0.en: * (You have the feeling you wouldn't learn anything.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6856_0.ja:
＊ (わざわざ見なくても
　 もう知っている気がする)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6862_0.ja:
いっしょに
乗ってやる

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6863_0.ja:
スージィは
乗らない

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6864_0.ja:
スージィは
きっと乗る

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6868_0.en: * (It's an advertisement for a giant ferris wheel.)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6870_0.ja:
＊ わぁ　すごい！
　 大きいね！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6871_0.en: * Makes the one at the festival look like a toy, haha!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6871_0.ja:
＊ これに比べたら
　 お祭りで乗ったやつなんて
　 おもちゃみたい！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6872_0.en: * I... I wonder if Susie would want to...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6872_0.ja:
＊ …ねえ　クリスはどう思う？
　 ス…スージィは…
　 観覧車とか…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6873_0.en: * ... Gosh, who am I kidding?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6873_0.ja:
＊ …やだ　わたし
　 なに聞いてるんだろ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6881_0.en: * Oh, so you can shake it when we reach the top?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6881_0.ja:
＊ …どうせ　てっぺんに
　 来たら　ゴンドラを
　 揺らすつもりでしょ…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6882_0.en: * Just like at the festival when we were kids?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6882_0.ja:
＊ 小さいころ
　 お祭りで　いっしょに
　 乗ったときみたいに。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6883_0.en: * I KNOW there's a catch with you, Kris! NO thanks!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6883_0.ja:
＊ クリスの　たくらむこと
　 なんて　お見とおしだよ！
　 だから　お断り！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6897_0.en: * Y-you're right! Even if I asked her, she'd...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6897_0.ja:
＊ だ…だよね…
　 誘ったって　きっと…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6898_0.en: * Probably just laugh at me.

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6899_0.en: * And, gosh, push me to the ground, and...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6899_0.ja:
＊ それから　きっと
　 地面に押し倒されて…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6900_0.en: * L-laugh at me some more, and then...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6900_0.ja:
＊ で　また笑われて…
　 それで…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6901_0.en: * (... What were we talking about again?)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6907_0.en: * R-really? Y-you really think so?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6907_0.ja:
＊ ほ…ほんと？
　 ほんとに　そう思う？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6908_0.en: * Faha, and coming from Susie Expert Kris! Thanks!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6908_0.ja:
＊ クリスが言うなら　間違い
　 ないね！　スージィのこと
　 なんでも知ってるもんね！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6910_0.en: * (Hey, Kris, how'd YOU become the Susie Expert!?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6910_0.ja:
＊ (ねえ　クリス…
　 どうして　スージィのこと
　 なんでも知ってるの！？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6915_0.ja:
ノエルと
いっしょに
乗ってやる

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6929_0.en: * I mean... S-sure, if you, um... really want to!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6929_0.ja:
＊ …っと　うん。
　 そんなに　いっしょに
　 乗りたいなら…　いいよ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6930_0.en: * You can, um, make up for when we were kids!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6930_0.ja:
＊ そうだね…
　 あの　お祭りの日の
　 埋め合わせ　させてあげる！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6825_0.en: * (... Since when did Kris get so...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6825_0.ja:
＊ (…クリスって
　 いつから　こんなに…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6827_0.en: * (N... no way, it's gotta be some kind of prank!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6827_0.ja:
＊ (…きっと　また
　 からかわれてるだけ
　 だよね！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6938_0.en: * Um, it's ok, I know you can't help being a goof.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6938_0.ja:
＊ …うん　いいよ。
　 クリスに　からかわれるのは
　 慣れてるから。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6939_0.en: * We ALL know you can't help it! Fahaha!!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6939_0.ja:
＊ クリスが
　 そういうコだって
　 みんな　知ってるから！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6950_0.en: * (It's a bed. Go to sleep?)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6958_0.en: * K-Kris, what if Noelle came in here...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6958_0.ja:
＊ クリス…　ノエルさんが
　 もどってきたら
　 どうするの…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6960_0.en: * Yeah, what if she has ticks? Get out of there!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6960_0.ja:
＊ そーだよ　あいつ
　 ノミがいるかもだぜ？
　 起きろよ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6966_0.ja: ＊ (どうせ　自分のベッドじゃない)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6994_0.ja:
サイバー
フィールド

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6999_0.en:
* (It's a door.)
* (Where will you go?)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7026_0.ja:
＊ (どういうわけか
　 もう　そこにいる)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7046_0.ja:
ごめん
パズル
やるね

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7052_0_b.en: * Kris? Are... you really going to leave me...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7052_0_b.ja:
＊ クリス…？　え…
　 本気で
　 わたしを置いてく気…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7062_0.ja:
＊ あ…　うん。
　 ありがとう…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7070_0.en: * ... h-huh? What did you say?

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7071_0.ja: ＊ ででででも…　ネズミが…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7082_0.ja:
＊ あ…　うん。
　 ありがとう…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7099_0.ja:
いっしょに
解こう！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7104_0.en: * L... Look, Kris! Another puzzle!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7104_0.ja:
＊ み…見て…！
　 またパズルだね…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6971_0.en: * H... How should we solve it this time?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_6971_0.ja:
＊ …今度は
　 どうやって解く？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7114_0.en: * Y... Yeah, you're right, Kris!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7114_0.ja:
＊ …うん！　そうだね！
　 そうしよう！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7115_0.en: * (I thought Kris was acting strange, but...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7115_0.ja:
＊ (クリス　なんだか様子が
　 ヘンな気がしたけど…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7116_0.en: * (I guess it was just another mean joke...?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7116_0.ja:
＊ (また　いつもの調子で
　 からかわれてた
　 だけかな…？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7158_0.en: * (Faha, Kris buying ME a ring...? Yeah, right!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7158_0.ja:
＊ (でも　クリスが
　 わたしに　指輪買ってくれる
　 なんて　ありえないよ！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7176_0.en: * H... huh? Kris, you'd... buy it for me...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7176_0.ja:
＊ えっ…　ホントに…？
　 クリス　買ってくれるの…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7177_0.en: * Sure, I guess... we could ask about it.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7177_0.ja:
＊ うん　そうだね…
　 聞くだけ聞いてみようか。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7178_0.en: * How much does it cost?

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7180_0.en: * Just a small fee of $~1!

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7182_0.en: * Huh? S-sorry, we don't have that much money!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7182_0.ja:
＊ えっ…　ご…ごめんなさい
　 わたしたち　そんなに
　 おカネ持ってないです！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7183_0.en: * (Still, it was nice of Kris to offer...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7183_0.ja:
＊ (クリスの気持ちは
　 うれしいけど…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7189_0.en: * Y-yeah, we don't need anything like that.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7189_0.ja:
＊ だ…だよね。指輪なんて
　 いらないよね。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7075_0.en: * You... were asking ME to get it?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7075_0.ja:
＊ えっと…　わたしが
　 おカネを出すってこと？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7076_0.en: * Kris, c'mon, you know we can't afford that...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7076_0.ja:
＊ ムリだよ…
　 そんな　おカネ…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7206_0.en: * Y-yeah, we don't need anything like that.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7206_0.ja:
＊ だ…だよね。指輪なんて
　 いらないよね。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7094_0.en: * Kris, I just told you, we... we don't have the money.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7094_0.ja:
＊ だから…　そんな　おカネ　
　 ないってば。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7095_0.en: * What... what are you asking me to do...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7095_0.ja:
＊ なに…？
　 わたしに　なにを
　 させたいの…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7096_0.en: * You... you aren't asking me to just...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7096_0.ja: ＊ まさか…　でも…　そんな…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7217_0.en: * K-Kris, no, I... not me, I could never...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7217_0.ja:
＊ ダメだよ　クリス…
　 ダメだってば…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7223_0.en: * Y-yeah, we don't need anything like that.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7223_0.ja:
＊ だ…だよね。指輪なんて
　 いらないよね。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7240_0.en: * Y-yeah, we don't need anything like that.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7240_0.ja:
＊ だ…だよね。指輪なんて
　 いらないよね。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7247_0.ja:
ノエルの
ちちおやに
あうため

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7248_0.ja:
ノエルに
あうため

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7254_0.en: * (Come on, it... it was just a bad dream...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7254_0.ja:
＊ (さっきのは…　ゆめだよね…
　 ぜんぶ　ただの　わるい　ゆめ…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7255_0.en: * (Even so, it was so real, I can't get it out of my mind...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7255_0.ja:
＊ (でも…　すごくリアルだった…
　 あたまに　やきついて
　 はなれない…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7256_0.en: * (... that voice, telling me what to do.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7256_0.ja:
＊ (…あの　こえ…
　 わたしに　しじしてきた…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7258_0.ja: ＊ (…とても　こわい　こえ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7261_0.en: * (Recently, there's been something... different... about them.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7261_0.ja:
＊ (さいきん　なんだか…
　 ようすが　ヘン)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7262_0.en: * (Why hasn't anyone else noticed it...?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7262_0.ja:
＊ (みんな　どうして
　 きづかないの…？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7263_0.en: * (I... I have to figure it out.)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7264_0.en: * (Why Kris is acting so strange...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7264_0.ja:
＊ (…どうして　クリスのようすが
　 おかしくなったのか)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7265_0.en: * (Why they keep coming... to the hospital...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7265_0.ja:
＊ (どうして…
　 なんども　びょういんに　くるのか)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7274_0.en: * K-Kris... how long have you been standing there!?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7274_0.ja:
＊ クリスッ…！
　 いつから　そこにいたの！？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7275_0.en: * Phew, you... haha, you really scared me, you know?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7275_0.ja:
＊ はぁ…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7277_0.en: * (There's nothing to be afraid of...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7277_0.ja: ＊ (だいじょうぶ　こわくない…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7278_0.en: * (After all, a dream is just a dream, right...?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7278_0.ja:
＊ (だって　あれは　ぜんぶ
　 ただの　ゆめだもん…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7297_0.en: * Why are you wearing... my watch?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7297_0.ja:
＊ どうして…
　 わたしの　うでどけい　してるの？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7304_0.ja:
あれは
ゆめじゃ
ないから

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7307_0.en: * (Then why did their voice just now... sound...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7307_0.ja:
＊ (いま　きこえた　こえ…
　 どうして…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7308_0.ja: ＊ (…あんなに　こわかったの…？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7247_0_b.en: * S-stop! Don't come any closer!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7247_0_b.ja:
＊ え…　な…なに！？
　 それいじょう　ちかづかないで！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7317_0.en: * Hey, Kris! Let's beat it already.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7317_0.ja: ＊ うし　いこうぜ　クリス！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7318_0.en: * Man, he kept telling me about Noelle, like...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7318_0.ja:
＊ ったく　あのおっさん
　 ノエルのこと　えんえん
　 くっちゃべってさ…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7319_0.en: * Her favorite things, places she'd like to go...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7319_0.ja:
＊ ノエルは　なにがすきだとか
　 よく　どこへいくとか…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7320_0.en: * No idea what the hell that was about.

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7324_0.en: * So, uh, the hell were you two doing?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7324_0.ja:
＊ あー　んで？
　 おまえら　ふたりで
　 なにやってんだ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7326_0.ja:
＊ あ　えっと…
　 べつに　なにも！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7327_0.en: * I was... I was just about to go home! U-umm... see you!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7327_0.ja:
＊ わ…わたし…　かえるね！
　 …バイバイ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7334_0.en: * Guess she's afraid of me again, huh...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7334_0.ja:
＊ まーた
　 こわがられてるっぽいな…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7335_0.ja:
＊ はぁ…
　 やっぱ　もったいねーな…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7336_0.en: * If she knew everything that happened was real, huh, Kris?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7336_0.ja:
＊ あれは　ぜんぶ
　 ゆめじゃないって　ノエルも

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7338_0.en: * C'mon, try to be a little more enthusiastic. Heh.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7338_0.ja:
＊ んだよ　クリス
　 ノリわりィな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7350_0.en: * (It's a box filled with bagels. Take one?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7350_0.ja:

　 入っている。１つ取る？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7378_0.ja:
＊ (箱のなかにはもう
　 ベーグルは　ない)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7385_0.en: * (You chose not to take a bagel.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7385_0.ja:
＊ (ベーグルを
　 取らないことにした)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7339_0.en: * (It's a manhole. There's a ladder leading inside.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7339_0.ja:
＊ (マンホールだ。
　 ハシゴで　なかに　おりられる)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7326_0_b.ja: ＊ どこへも　行けないよ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7327_0_b.en: * Kris, there's... the path is blocked, isn't it?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7327_0_b.ja:
＊ だって…
　 道が　ふさがってるでしょ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7359_0.en: * Kris... what are you doing?

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7360_0.en: * Kris, is... is everything okay?

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7392_0.en: * Kris, there's lightning in the way...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7392_0.ja:
＊ あのね　電流が流れてて
　 道が…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7393_0.en: * If... if we move any further... I'll be... I'll be...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7393_0.ja:
＊ これ以上…　進んだら…
　 わたし…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7394_0.en: * K... Kris, you didn't really hear what I said earlier, did you?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7394_0.ja:
＊ ねえ　クリス…
　 さっき　わたしが言ったこと

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7395_0.en: * You... you wouldn't... let me...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7462_0.en:
* (It's a machine that sells pre-fountain refreshments.)
* (1 bagel is $120. Buy?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7462_0.ja:
＊ (自販機だ。
　 泉前フードが　売られている)
＊ (ベーグル１コ　$120。買う？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7485_0.ja:
＊ (どういうわけか…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7503_0.ja: ＊ (マニュアルだ。どの項目を読む？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7511_0.en: * If you SPARE or PACIFY enough enemies of the same type, they will be RECRUITed.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7511_0.ja:
＊ 同じタイプの敵を　一定数以上
　 「にがす」か「スリープ」させると
　 その敵が　「なかま」になります。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7512_0.en: * RECRUITs will appear in your TOWN. Wonder what happens if you get them all...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7512_0.ja:
＊ 「なかま」は　キャッスルタウンに

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7513_0.ja:
＊ なかまになる敵の情報は　各エリアの

　 (一部のボスは除きます)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7519_0.ja:
＊ セーブポイントで
　「そうこ」メニューを
　 使えるようになりました。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7520_0.en: * When you're out of space, ITEMs you find or BUY will be sent to your STORAGE.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7520_0.ja:
＊ 「アイテム」を持ちきれなくなると
　 以降　拾ったり買ったりしたものは
　 「そうこ」に送られます。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7521_0.en: * Feel free to put things inside you might not be able to use yet.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7521_0.ja:
＊ しばらく使わなそうなアイテムは
　 「そうこ」に入れておくと

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7583_0.ja:
＊ 「LOST」した敵は

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7584_0.ja:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7590_0.en: * (Who has time to read a book in the Cyber World?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7590_0.ja:
＊ (サイバーワールドで

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7648_0.ja:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7658_0.ja: ＊ (シャドウジェムを手に入れた)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7676_0.ja:
＊ (ラルセイは
　 「なかまを失うこと」という

うん

楽しい

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7827_0.ja:

　 欲しいモンあったら　ポイントで
　 買えるからよぉ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7830_0.ja:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7841_0.ja:

　 なんか　買いてぇんか？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7842_0.ja:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7856_0.ja:

　 ここにいる　みぃ～んな

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7927_0.ja: ＊ んだよ　シケてんな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7940_0.ja: ＊ (怪しい引き出しだ…　開ける？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7988_0.ja:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7989_0.ja:

　 ダークドルのみ使用可能です)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_7990_0.ja:

＊ (ポイントで　アイテムゲット！)

力ずくで
押し通る

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8215_0.en:
Got Lost
looking for
the exit
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8215_0.ja:
出口を
さがしてたら
迷子になった

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8218_0.en:
Back here to
do good deeds
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8218_0.ja:
心を入れ替えて
もどってきた

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8223_0.en: * You aren't supposed to be back here. Explain yourself!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8223_0.ja:
＊ オマエたち　なんでここにいる！？
　 説明しろ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8253_0.en: * Y'know if you lick old screens it makes rainbows?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8253_0.ja:
＊ 古いテレビの画面って 
　 なめると　ニジが
　 出るんだぜ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8263_0.en: * Heh, 'course you would know that... weirdo.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8263_0.ja:
＊ ヘッ　だろうと思ったぜ…
　 キメぇヤツ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8269_0.en: * Dude, I wasn't saying we do it RIGHT NOW.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8269_0.ja:
＊ ベツに　いまやれっつった
　 わけじゃねーから！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8373_0.en: * Need any other instructions, or should we start the FINAL MATCH!?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8373_0.ja:
＊ 細かいルール説明　聞きますか？
　 それとも　さっさと最終マッチを
　 始めちゃっても　いいかな～！？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8403_0.en: * Kris, are we all ready to start Round 2?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8403_0.ja:
＊ クリス　第２ラウンドへ
　 進む準備は　いい？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8413_0.en: * Yeah, what's the rush, anyway?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8413_0.ja:
＊ ま　いそぐことも
　 ねーしな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8487_0.ja:
＊ (ソファだ。
　 この上で　眠ることができる)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8488_0.en: * (If you go back to sleep, you may miss a lot of important things.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8488_0.ja:
＊ (二度寝すると　大事なことを
　 たくさん見逃すかもしれない)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8514_0.en:
* (POINTs to ITEMs!)
* (Use the vending machine?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8514_0.ja:
＊ (ポイントで　アイテムゲット！)
＊ (自動販売機を使う？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8547_0.en: * Hey! Hey, you! You wanna be an S rank, don't you...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8547_0.ja:
＊ ちょっと！　そこのアンタさん！
　 Ｓランクに　なりたいでっしゃろ…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8548_0.en: * Well, you didn't hear it from me, but I might know a way.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8548_0.ja:
＊ だれにも言わんて　約束してくれたら 
　 ワイが　なんとか　したりまっせ…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8549_0.ja:
＊ …ただし…
　 1500ポイント　くれたらな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8550_0.ja: ＊ そう。1500ですわ。どないします？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8572_0.en: * Lessee... 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6... Hey, this isn't enough!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8572_0.ja:
＊ どれどれ…いーち…にーい…さーん…
　 しーい…ごーお…ろーく…
　 あかん！　足りひんわ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8573_0.en: * If you don't have enough now, it's too late! Try harder next time!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8573_0.ja:
＊ いまの時点で　足りひんのやったら 
　 もう　手おくれですわ。
　 次　がんばりや！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8580_0.en: * Well, your loss. ... or, I guess you won. But poorly. Right?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8580_0.ja:
＊ そら　残念…
　 アンタら　勝ちはしたけども 
　 残念な勝ちでしたやろ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8621_0.en: * (It's a door with a PARENTAL LOCK system to prevent the viewing of R-RATED MOVIES.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8621_0.ja:
＊ (とびらだ。年齢制限のある映画は
　 見られないように　ロックが
　 かかっている)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8624_0.en: * (It's a door with a PARENTAL LOCK system to prevent the viewing of MUSIC VIDEOS.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8624_0.ja:
＊ (とびらだ。ミュージックビデオは
　 見られないように　ロックが
　 かかっている)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8653_0.en: * (It's a parental lock. It seems to be undefined.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8653_0.ja:
＊ (とびらに　ペアレンタルロックが
　 ついている。暗証番号は
　 設定されていないようだ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8655_0.en: * Oi, Kris! How were the games, luv?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8655_0.ja:
＊ クリス！
　 ゲームは　どうだったけ？
　 楽しかったけぇ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8671_0.en: * I see, I see... It's all well and good if you feel that way.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8671_0.ja:
＊ そうかぁ…
　 クリスが　そう思ったんなら
　 よかったよぉ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8672_0.en: * Ol' man Tenna's got to have SOMEONE appreciate him, I suppose...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8672_0.ja:
＊ 楽しんでくれる　ひとがいて 
　 テナも　うれしいだろうよぉ…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8687_0.en: * See, I KNEW you wouldn't like it. Something's missing, right?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8687_0.ja:
＊ そう言うと思ったよぉ。
　 なぁ～んか　もの足りなかったな？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8693_0.en: * Some action... Some mystery... Maybe some more... freedom?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8693_0.ja:
＊ アクションやら…ナゾやら…
　 …自由度…やらな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8694_0.en: * (Just between you and me, if you can get in the S-Ranker's room...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8694_0.ja:
＊ (まあでも　ここだけの話…
　 Ｓランクの部屋には…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8701_0.en: * (Good thing we've got the REAL game, eh, luv?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8701_0.ja:
＊ (まあでも　ちゃあんと
　 “ホンモノの”　ゲームも
　 あるからなぁ　問題ナシだぁ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8719_0.en: * Um, shall we go back to the stage now?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8719_0.ja:
＊ えっと…
　 そろそろステージに
　 もどる？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8740_0.ja:
ロックに
説明は
いらないぜ

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8744_0.en: * Haha! Just kidding! Anyway, are you ready to ROCK!?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8744_0.ja:
＊ なぁ～んちゃって！！
　 そろそろ本番　いっちゃっても
　 いいかな～！？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8770_0.ja:
そうでも
ないです

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8774_0.en: * You's a cheater, ain't ya.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8774_0.ja: ＊ オマエら　イカサマ師だな？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8793_0.en: * Now, honesty, that'll take you somewhere.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8793_0.ja:
＊ よし　正直者は
　 進みたい場所へ　自由に進める。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8805_0.en: * Then we's got no business!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8805_0.ja: ＊ だったら　用はないぜ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8825_0.en: * The entrance...? That can be arranged.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8825_0.ja: ＊ 入り口か…？　よし　わかった。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8829_0.en: * The entrance...? Well, it's blocked by a puzzle. Solve it and head left.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8829_0.ja:
＊ 入り口か…？　いまはパズルで
　 ふさがってるから　そいつを
　 解いてから左へ進め。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8840_0.en: * You's was already heading that way, weren't ya, Kris?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8840_0.ja:
＊ クリス　オマエとっくに
　 そこへ　向かってたな？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8854_0.en: * Da boss is lookin' for cheaters. You's ain't seen any cheaters, have ya?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8854_0.ja:
＊ うちのボスが　イカサマ師どもを
　 探してる。
　 イカサマ師　見てねえよな？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8862_0.en: * Too bad... naw, too good.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8862_0.ja: ＊ それは残念…いや　よかった。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8864_0.en: * Too good... naw, too bad.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8864_0.ja: ＊ それはよかった…いや　残念だ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8867_0.en: * What the -- say it in da cage!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8867_0.ja:
＊ なっ…　おしおきケージに
　 入ってろ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8884_0.ja: ＊ クリス。用は　すんだか？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8890_0.en: * Kris, what's that TICKET? Nevermind, hurry or Mr. Tenna's gonna get mad.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8890_0.ja:
＊ クリス　その切符は　なんだ？
　 まあいい。急がないと　ミスター・
　 テナに　どやされる。行くぞ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8907_0.en: * Good. I hadn't arranged the way back yet.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8907_0.ja:
＊ よかった。まだ帰り道の準備を
　 してないからな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8916_0.ja:
胸のボタンを
ボコスカ押す

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8964_0.ja: ＊ (サインが　欲しいようだ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8993_0.ja:
$250で
TVディナーを
買う

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9013_0.en: * Kris! This world doesn't take cash. Instead, you'll earn POINTs!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9013_0.ja:
＊ クリスはん　ここじゃ
　 現金　持ってても　意味あらへん。
　 買い物は　ポイントで　しますねん。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9014_0.en: * (So how about one last chance to use your $$$...?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9014_0.ja:
＊ (ちゅうわけで　最後に　パーッと
　 $$$使こたら　どーでっしゃろ？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9070_0.en: * ... actually, you don't have any money.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9070_0.ja: ＊ …ちゅうか　一文ナシですやん。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9071_0.en: * Gee, ever think of saving some from your other adventures...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9071_0.ja:
＊ 別の冒険したときに　なんで
　 ためとかんかったん…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9078_0.en: * ... you already have too much stuff!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9078_0.ja:
＊ …なんや　もう　持ちもの
　 いっぱいですやん！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9083_0.en: * ... wait, you don't have any money anyway.

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9124_0.en: * (... and it seems you've already chosen.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9124_0.ja: ＊ (…すでに　選択ずみのようだ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9137_0.en: * The only ranch WE need is "cool," right, Kris?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9137_0.ja:
＊ 牧場は「OK」じゃねえ。
　 NGだ。だろ　クリス？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9203_0.en: * What the hell took you so long?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9203_0.ja:
＊ どんだけ待たせんだよ…
　 何やってたんだ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9254_0.en: * (The sign says "BALL MACHINE User's Guide. Read it?")
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9254_0.ja:
＊ (かんばんには　こう書いてある。
　 「ボールマシン ユーザーガイド
　 読む？」)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9264_0.en: * ("Welcome to BALL MACHINE. Insert points to gain PRIZES.")
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9264_0.ja:
＊ (「ボールマシンに
　 ポイントを入れて
　 景品を　ゲットしよう」)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9265_0.en: * ("The minimum is 100 POINTs. MORE POINTs increase GOLD CHANCE.")
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9265_0.ja:
＊ (「100ポイントから　ご利用OK。
　 入れるポイントを増やすほど
　 ゴールドチャンスが　上がるぞ」)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9266_0.en: * ("Even if you miss GOLD PRIZE, next time GOLD CHANCE increases faster!")
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9266_0.ja:
＊ (「ゴールドプライズを逃しても 
　 次回ご利用時に　ゴールドチャンスが
　 上がりやすくなるぞ！」)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9267_0.en: * ("HIT the GOLD PRIZE, GOLD CHANCE will reset... etc.")
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9267_0.ja:
＊ (「ゴールドプライズを
　 ゲットすると　ゴールドチャンスは
　 リセットされるぞ…　etc.」)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9268_0.en: * ("You turned to the camera and thanked Tenna for a great toy! Thanks, Tenna!")
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9268_0.ja:
＊ (「カメラの　ほうを　向いて 
　 テナに　『ステキな　おもちゃを
　 ありがとう！』と　伝えた」)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9269_0.en: * (... is, all part of what it said on the sign.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9269_0.ja: ＊ (…と　かんばんに　書いてある)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9273_0.en: * (The sign says "You didn't choose to read the User's Guide. Avert eyes!")
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9273_0.ja:
＊ (かんばんには　こう書いてある。
　 「ユーザーガイドを　読まないと
　 決めた。なら　こっち見るな」）

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9287_0.en: * (It's a poster for the COOKING CHALLENGE!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9287_0.ja:
＊ (「お料理チャレンジ」の
　 ポスターだ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9300_0.en: * (Here are some tips for the HIGH SCORES.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9300_0.ja:
＊ (お料理チャレンジで
　 ハイスコアを出すコツを
　 お教えしましょう！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9301_0.en: * (The taller a stack you throw, the more points you get!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9301_0.ja:
＊ (料理を高く積み上げて投げるほど
　 獲得ポイントが　多くなります)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9302_0.en: * (SPECIAL GUESTS are worth more points!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9302_0.ja:
＊ (「SPECIAL GUEST」に
　 料理を提供すると
　 ポイントを　大量にゲットできます)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9303_0.en: * (Jumping over fire is worth 2 points...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9303_0.ja:
＊ (炎を飛びこえると
　 ２ポイント獲得)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9304_0.en: * (And, catching food while jumping is worth 1 point!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9304_0.ja:
＊ (ジャンプしながら
　 料理をキャッチすると
　 １ポイント獲得します)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9322_0.en: * (It's a poster for the ROCK VIDEO!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9322_0.ja: ＊ (「ロックビデオ」のポスターだ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9335_0.en: * (Tips and tricks to ROCK OUT!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9335_0.ja:
＊ (ロックしまくるコツを
　 伝授するぜ！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9336_0.en: * (Perfect timing means extra points! A GOLD LIGHT means you nailed the note!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9336_0.ja:
＊ (タイミングが　パーフェクトなら
　 追加ポイント ゲット！　ゴールドの
　 光は　ジャストヒットのしるしだ！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9337_0.en: * (LEFT and RIGHT can be used to play notes as well!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9337_0.ja:
＊ (「左」または「右」キーでも
　 演奏OK！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9338_0.en: * (Make sure to HOLD DOWN THE BUTTON for long notes.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9338_0.ja:
＊ (ロングトーンは
　 ボタン長押しだぞ！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9356_0.en: * (It's a poster for the MONSTER MOVIE!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9356_0.ja:
＊ (「カイジュウ映画」の
　 ポスターだ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9378_0.en: * (It's a giant monster movie! Bash everything!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9378_0.ja:
＊ (巨大カイジュウが
　 街を破壊しまくるぞ！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9379_0.en: * (Destroy all houses in one attack for BONUS POINTs!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9379_0.ja:
＊ (家を一気に全部こわせば
　 ボーナスポイント　ゲット！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9380_0.en: * (Survive at the end for the highest score...!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9380_0.ja:
＊ (最後のこうげきを
　 乗り切れば　ハイスコア…！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9381_0.en: * (There are no rewards for getting a high score though.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9381_0.ja:
＊ (ただし　ハイスコアを出しても
　 賞品は　ないぞ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9393_0.ja:
お料理番組を
プレイ

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9399_0.en: * (It's the door to the COOKING SHOW! Play it!?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9399_0.ja:
＊ (「お料理番組」の　とびらだ。
　 プレイする？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9429_0.ja:
ロック
ビデオを
プレイ

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9435_0.en: * (It's the door to the ROCK VIDEO! Play it!?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9435_0.ja:
＊ (「ロックビデオ」の　とびらだ。
　 プレイする？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9471_0.en: * (Which mode will you play on?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9471_0.ja: ＊ (どちらのモードで　プレイする？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9511_0.en: * Hey, hey! This here's an extra special game... It's LOCKED, you know!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9511_0.ja:
＊ クリスはん！　こっちこっち！
　 スペシャルゲームでっせ…
　 ま　カギ　かかってますけども…！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9512_0.en: * That is... unless you pay 500 POINTs.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9512_0.ja:
＊ ただし…
　 500ポイント　出してくれるんなら
　 話は　別ですわ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9530_0.en: * Seriously? A REAL gamer would pay ANY transaction!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9530_0.ja:
＊ なんでやねん。ガチのゲーマー
　 やったら　ガンガン課金して
　 ナンボでっしゃろ！？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9573_0.ja:
ナゾゲームを
プレイ

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9577_0_b.ja:
カイジュウ
映画を
プレイ

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9546_0.en: * (It's the door to the ~1! Play it!?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9546_0.ja: ＊ (~1への 　 とびらだ。プレイする？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9612_0.en: * (The door says "Exclusive Z-RANK changing room!")
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9612_0.ja:
＊ (とびらには
　 「Ｚランク専用　更衣室！」と
　 書いてある)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9636_0.ja:
手伝う
または
手伝わない

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9642_0.en: * Susie! Blue Kris! I'm doing my Hurricane Attack. Want to help!?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9642_0.ja:
＊ スージィ！　ブルーの
　 クリス！　ハリケーン
　 こうげき　手伝って！？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9664_0.en: * Spin, spin, spin, spin, spin, spin, spin, spin...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9664_0.ja:
＊ グルグル　グルグル 
　 グルグル　グルグル 
　 グルグル　グルグル…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9672_0.ja:
スージィを
見守ろう

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9673_0.ja:
のんびり
しとこう

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9678_0.en: * And just watch from here...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9678_0.ja:
＊ ボクたちは　ここで
　 見守っていよう…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9707_0.en: * Like... chill with our eyes closed?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9707_0.ja:
＊ のんびり…っていうのは…
　 目を　つぶって？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9736_0.en: * Would you... like to talk about something?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9736_0.ja:
＊ …えっ…と…
　 何か　話したいこと　ある？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9795_0.en:
Trying to
close eyes and
think about
Susie
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9795_0.ja:
目を閉じて
スージィのことを
考えてた

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9800_0.en: * So what the hell were you two doing?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9800_0.ja:
＊ …２人で
　 なにやってたんだよ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9845_0.en: * ... we gotta tell Tenna this is the last game.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9845_0.ja:
＊ これで最後だって
　 テナに伝えねーとな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9875_0.en: * ... huh? Kris, you really want to talk to Tenna?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9875_0.ja:
＊ …は？　クリス…
　 おまえ　１人でテナと話しに
　 いくのか？　マジかよ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9887_0.en: * Whatever you wanna do, I guess...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9887_0.ja: ＊ フン…　好きにしろよ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9905_0.en: * Oh, you three! It's me, Elnina! I've never felt more moisturized!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9905_0.ja:
＊ あら　さっきの　みんな！
　 ワタシよ　エルニーナよ！
　 最高に　シットリ　いい気分よ！！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9906_0.en: * The single life's never felt this cool and collected! Ask me about anything!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9906_0.ja:
＊ シングルライフが　こんなに
　 おだやかで　ステキだったなんて…！
　 さあ　なんでも聞いてちょうだい！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9929_0.ja:
エルニーナは
強いから
１人で平気

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9930_0.ja:
すぐに
新しい恋人が
現れるでしょう

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9935_0.en: * Without him to balance me, my only forecast is rain... running down my face.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9935_0.ja:
＊ ラニーノがいないと 
　 ワタシの予報は　いつも雨…
　 ワタシのホホを伝う　涙雨…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9958_0.en: * Oh, you three! It is I, Lanino. The Green Room was, BUSY, so I'm in here.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9958_0.ja:
＊ ああ　キミたち　さっきの！
　 ボクだよ　ラニーノだよ。楽屋は
　 混雑してたから…こっちへ来たんだ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9959_0.en: * Need any, ahem, assistance from a brave and independent moon?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9959_0.ja:
＊ 自立心の強い　勇気ある月に
　 聞きたいことが　あれば 
　 ボクが　いつでも　力になるよ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9982_0.ja:
ラニーノは
強いから
１人で平気

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9983_0.ja:
すぐに
新しい恋人が
現れるでしょう

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9988_0.en: * Without her moisture, my heart and skin have become so... so, dry.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_9988_0.ja:
＊ 彼女のうるおいが　なかったら
　 ボクは　心もお肌も
　 カラッカラのパサッパサだ…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10005_0.ja:
スージィに
気分はどうか
聞いてみる

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10006_0.ja:
ラルセイに
気分はどうか
聞いてみる

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10011_0.en: * (I wonder if you should... ask Susie how she's doing...?)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10011_0.ja:
＊ (スージィに…
　 気分はどうか
　 聞いてみない…？)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10028_0.ja:
クリスは
夢じゃない

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10029_0.ja:
スージィとの
友情は
ホンモノだよ

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10034_0.en: * (... doesn't mess me up so much.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10034_0.ja:
＊ (…べつに　ショックでも
　 なんでもねーよ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10051_0.en:
It's ok to
take it easy
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10051_0.ja:
肩の力を
抜いても
いいんだよ

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10052_0.ja:
すべきことに
集中しろ

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10057_0.en: * I accidentally forgot about everything for a moment.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10057_0.ja:
＊ 一瞬　いろんなこと
　 全部　忘れちゃってたよ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10074_0.ja:
スージィとは
行かない

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10075_0.ja:
自分からだって
言う

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10080_0.en: * ... and tell Susie it was from me...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10080_0.ja:
＊ スージィに 
　 ボクからだって言って 
　 あげてくれないかな…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10104_0.en: * Who... are you intending to go with...?

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10127_1.en: * Do you want to CHALLENGE AGAIN!?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10127_1.ja: ＊ またチャレンジしてくれるかな～！？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10219_0.en: * Don't bother, Kris. Ramb's already turned to stone a bit ago...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10219_0.ja:
＊ クリスはん　話しかけてもムダ
　 でっせ。ラムはんは　ちょっと前に
　 石になってもうたさかい…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10220_0.en: * He was a plug, but because you played with him like any other toy, it made him feel special.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10220_0.ja:
＊ ただの電源タップやったのに 
　 クリスはんが　他のおもちゃと
　 同じように遊んでやってたもんで…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10221_0.en: * Might have given him a little bit of an ego, in fact...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10221_0.ja:
＊ 特別な気分に　なってたいうか…
　 ちぃとばかし　うぬぼれてたんかも
　 しれまへんなぁ…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10222_0.ja: ＊ この話　まだ聞きまっか？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10236_0.en: * Always condescending to any plan, saying "what's best for Kris?"
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10236_0.ja:
＊ ワイらの計画に　いちいち　ケチ
　 つけますのんや。「それってクリスの
　 ためになるけ？」ゆうてな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10237_0.en: * Couldn't get rid of him, so Tenna made him "work the stand"...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10237_0.ja:
＊ 追い出すわけにもいかへんから 
　 テナはんが“売店担当”に
　 しましてん…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10238_0.en: * Us from Card Castle fit in fine. Him? He never really belonged.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10238_0.ja:
＊ ワイらみたいに　カルタス城出身なら
　 ともかく　ラムはんは
　 ワイらとは　違いますねん。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10239_0.en: * His first day at this stand, he joked "how about the usual?"... no one laughed!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10239_0.ja:
＊ 売店で働きだした初日に 
　 「いつものでいいかい？」ゆうてな…
　 見事に　ダダすべりしてましたわ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10240_0.en: * Mixing drinks alone for himself, he wasn't allowed to handle the points...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10240_0.ja:
＊ ポイント触らせてもらえへん
　 もんやから　だぁれも頼んでへんのに
　 ドリンク作って　自分で飲んで…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10241_0.en: * No one will shed a tear for him. Inside, he was probably stone already.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10241_0.ja:
＊ コイツが石になって　悲しむヤツは
　 おらへん。きっと　心はとっくに
　 石になっとったんちゃいまっか？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10245_0.en: * Ramb... well, he was like Tenna, I guess.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10245_0.ja:
＊ ラムはんも　テナはんも…
　 ある意味　似たもの同士かも
　 しれまへんなぁ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10246_0.en: * Two guys trapped in the past... just different ones.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10246_0.ja:
＊ ２人とも　過去に　とらわれて…
　 まあ　それぞれ　ちがう
　 過去ですけども。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10251_0.ja:
＊ ほうでっか。
　 そのほうが　ワイも気がラクですわ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10266_0.ja: ＊ ポイントを＄に変換する？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10334_0.en: * Been a while! I got caught smuggling TV Dinners for DARK DOLLARS.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10334_0.ja:
＊ ひさしぶりやな！　TVディナー
　 密売して　ダークドルかせいどったら
　 パクられてもーたわ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10335_0.en: * But that hasn't stopped me. Wanna buy a TV Dinner?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10335_0.ja:
＊ ま　そんなことで　商売やめる気ィ
　 あらへんけどな。
　 どや？　TVディナー買うてくか？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10355_0.en: * You're the jerk wanted for violence, right?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10355_0.ja:
＊ アンタ　なんでも力ずくで解決する
　 アホンダラやな？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10356_0.en: * ... heh, I can't believe I'm dealing with a criminal.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10356_0.ja:
＊ …さすがのワイも　犯罪者相手に
　 商売するとは　思いまへんでしたわ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10357_0.en: * How about it? Want to buy a TV Dinner?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10357_0.ja:
＊ どないでっか？
　 TVディナー　買うてくか？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10387_0.en: * ... you already have too much stuff!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10387_0.ja:
＊ …なんや！　もう　持ちもの
　 いっぱいですやん！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10393_0.en: * Hey! Looks like you couldn't carry all 3.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10393_0.ja: ＊ あれ！　３つも　持てませんやん。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10394_0.en: * That's okay... I'll still keep your money anyway.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10394_0.ja:
＊ 心配いりまへんで…
　 おカネは　このまま
　 もろときますさかい。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10395_0.en: * ... what? Hey, look who you're doing business with.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10395_0.ja:
＊ …なんでっか？
　 罪人から　モノ買うゆうんは 
　 そうゆうことでっせ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10400_0.en: * ... wait, you don't have any money anyway.

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10408_0.ja:
TVワールド
エントランス

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10414_0.en:
* (It's a door.)
* (Where will you go?)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10421_0.ja: ＊ (しかし　なにも起こらなかった)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10447_0.ja:
＊ (どういうわけか
　 もう　そこにいる)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10486_0.en: * (You tried to use the console, but nothing happened.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10486_0.ja:
＊ (ゲーム機を使おうとした。
　 が　何も起こらなかった)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10498_0.en: * Huh? It's a "reminder manual" I was revising...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10498_0.ja:
＊ え…？　これ…
　 ボクが書いた
　 「おさらいマニュアル」…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10499_0.en: * How'd it get here, exactly?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10499_0.ja:
＊ どうして
　 こんなところに…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10509_0.en: * (SPARE enemies whose names become YELLOW!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10509_0.ja: ＊ (名前が　きいろくなった敵は 　 逃がしてあげよう！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10510_0.en: * (Use PACIFY on TIRED enemies whose names are BLUE!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10510_0.ja: ＊ (名前が青い敵は 　 「くたびれ」てるよ。 　 「スリープ」で　眠らせよう)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10511_0.en: * (And... remember Susie and Ralsei's S-Action and R-Action, too!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10511_0.ja:
＊ (スージィと　ラルセイの
　 Ｓアクションと　Ｒアクションも
　 お忘れなく！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10537_0.en:
A tea that has deteriorated after a short while
due to its poor craftsmanship. +10HP
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10537_0.ja:
ザツに　いれたせいで　少し時間がたっただけで
味が落ちた　お茶。+10HP

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10567_0.en: * ~1 used the ROTTEN TEA!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_10567_0.ja: ＊ ~1は　くさったティーを使った！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_211_0.ja: ＊ Why, Kris, you don't have to do that...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_221_0.ja:
＊ Oh, thank you, Kris!
＊ I will!

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1572_0.ja: ＊ Kris, I need to grade these assignments.

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1573_0.ja: ＊ Perhaps you should go to bed...?

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1574_0.ja: ＊ You do not look very well...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3033_0.ja:
＊ クリスも　すっかり
　 おおきくなっちゃって…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3034_0.ja:
＊ あなたも　じきに
　 だいがくへ
　 いってしまうのね…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_3038_0.ja:
＊ あかいツノが　ついた
　 カチューシャを
　 かってあげたでしょう？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8103_0.ja:
楽しそうだから
100フロア
やろう

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8107_0.ja:
＊ だーかーらー　チート
　 しよーぜっつってんの。
　 どうする　クリス？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8277_0.ja:
大丈夫
コツを
教えて
あげるよ

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8282_0.ja:
＊ あっ…！　み…見ないで…
　 初心者だから…ヘタクソで…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8283_0.ja:
＊ …クリス　よかったら
　 アドバイスして
　 くれないかな…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8297_0.ja:
＊ わぁ　ありがとう！
　 ボク　ちゃんとメモを
　 取って　勉強するね！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8298_0.ja:
＊ そしたら…ボクもじょうずに
　 なって　クリスといっしょに
　 遊べるようになるかな…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8302_0.ja:
＊ クリス！　見て！
　 ひとりで２ポイント
　 ゲットできたよ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8304_0.ja:
＊ なあ　クリス　ラルセイに
　 ゲーム実況動画やらせたら
　 おもしろそうじゃね？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8316_0.ja:
＊ …ねえ　スージィ。
　 クリスが「ダッサ」って…
　 それって…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8318_0.ja:
＊ あ？　あー…
　 それはだな…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8319_0.ja:
＊ ダッサッ！　ダッサッ！
　 ダッサッ！　ダッサッ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8322_0.ja:
＊ アハハハハ！
　 ふたりとも　ホントに
　 おもしろいなぁ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8326_0.ja: ＊ ダッサ？　ダッサダッサ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_8462_0.ja:
サンタは
いる
うちのパパだ

scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.en:
A wooden practice blade with a carbon-
reinforced core.
scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.ja: 芯にカーボン素材を用いた練習用の木刀。
なんだよこれ！？　わりばしか？
…おまえ　剣持ってたのかよ！？
クリス…これは　キミのでしょ。

scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.en:
Beginner's ax forged from the
mane of a dragon whelp.
scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.ja:
子ドラゴンのたてがみで作った
初心者用のアックス。
こんなのは　もう卒業したぜ
ええぇ…ちょっと大きいな…

scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.en:
A basic scarf made of lightly
magical fiber.
scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.ja:
わずかに魔力を帯びた毛糸で編んだ
シンプルなマフラー。
フカフカだ！　触ってみて！
え… わたし　寒くないよ？

scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.en: A black-and-orange sword with a bat hilt.
scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.ja:
柄にコウモリをあしらった
黒とオレンジ色のソード。

scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.en:
A glossy ax from a block warrior.
Suitable for heroes.
scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.ja:
ブロック戦士たちが持っていたテカテカのオノ。
勇者にふさわしい武器。
ま　どーしてもっつうなら…

scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.en:
Skull-emblazoned scythe-ax.
Reduces Rudebuster's cost by 10
scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.ja:
ドクロのマークが刻まれた大ガマのような
形状のアックス。ルードバスターのコスト10減。
さあ　ゲームを始めよう！
ええぇ…悪モノっぽすぎるよ…
え…？　笑いかけてきた…？

scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.en:
Mossy rapier with a clover emblem.
Increases $ found by 5%.
scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.ja:
クローバーのエンブレムがついた
こけむしたレイピア。
獲得する$が5％増える。
ボクの好みの緑色じゃないな…

scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.en: Okay! ...? What do you mean, unused!?
scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.ja: オッケー！　…え？　「ボツ」？　どういうイミ！？

scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.en: A rugged scarf that cuts enemies like a dagger.
scr_weaponinfo_slash_scr_weaponinfo_gml_.ja: ダガーのように敵を突くボロボロのマフラー。

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_81_0.en: * Damnit... what is it doing here...?
obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_81_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_82_0.en: * I guess it made the fountain, and now...
obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_82_0.ja:
＊ 闇の泉を作ったのは

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_83_0.en: * ... it's looking for someone else to...
obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_83_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_193_0.en: * Kris, you... the glass, I didn't notice... it...
obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_193_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_195_0.en: * Umm, I'll... Here, let me heal it!
obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_195_0.ja:
＊ …うし…まかせろ。
　 いま　オレが回復してやる！

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_233_0.en: * Th... that wasn't enough, huh...
obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_233_0.ja:
＊ …クソッ…ダメだ。

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_331_0.en: * Could you tell me how to...
obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_331_0.ja:
＊ ラルセイ　教えてくれよ。
　 どうやったら…

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_333_0.en: * Susie, could you move out of the way?
obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_333_0.ja:
＊ スージィ　ちょっと
　 どいてくれるかな？

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_384_0.en: * Kris... Kris, are you okay?

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_399_0.en: * Umm, I tried to uh, heal, but...
obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_399_0.ja:
＊ …オレが回復しようと
　 したんだけどさ…

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_418_0.en: * Susie, I know you were just trying to help, but...
obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_418_0.ja:
＊ うん。自分の力で
　 治したかったんだよね？
　 でも…

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_419_0.en: * If someone's really hurt, don't... try to fix it alone, okay?
obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_419_0.ja:
＊ だれかが　大ケガしたときは…
　 ひとりで　なんとかしようと
　 しないでね。

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_421_0.en: * ... uh, yeah. Okay. Got it.

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_505_0.en: * So, hey, uh, ~1's together!
obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_505_0.ja: ＊ てかさ…　 　 また　 ~1が 　 勢ぞろいだな。

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_506_0.en: * We gonna, uh, pose now?

obj_ch4_DCA02_slash_Step_0_gml_508_0.ja: ＊ うん！　そうだね…やろう！

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_115_0.ja: ＊ これ　オレたちのことだよな？

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_117_0.en: * Yes, Susie! We are the Heroes of the Prophecy...
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_117_0.ja:
＊ そうだよ　スージィ！
　 ボクたちは　予言に語られる
　 勇者で…

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_124_0.en: * ... Which, I, was trying to explain when we met...
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_124_0.ja:
＊ …初めて会ったときに
　 この話をしようと
　 思ったんだけど…

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_126_0.en: * Okay, yeah, yeah, I get it.
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_126_0.ja:
＊ …ああ。聞かなくて
　 悪かったよ。

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_133_0.en: * Yeah, guess you said something like that, huh.
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_133_0.ja:
＊ そうそう。たしか
　 そんな話してたよな。

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_137_0.en: * Still... kinda... cool to see us up there, y'know?
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_137_0.ja:
＊ …こうやって
　 あらためて見ると…
　 ヤバくね？

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_139_0.en: * ... Kinda makes me feel like...

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_197_0.en: * Hey, who the hell's messing with us!?
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_197_0.ja:
＊ うぉい！！　だれだよ！
　 ケンカ売ってんのか！？

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_405_0.ja:
＊ どっからでも
　 かかってこいよ！！

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_533_0.ja: ＊ なにを　やっとるんだね？

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_560_0.en: * Wh... who... huh... what the HELL are YOU doing!?
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_560_0.ja:
＊ だっ…だれっ…！
　 な…なんなんだよ！？

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_578_0.en: * Lookin' for the light switch.
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_578_0.ja: ＊ 明かりのスイッチを　さがしとった。

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_592_0.en: * But, hrm. Seems I got a little lost.
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_592_0.ja: ＊ …が　どうやら道に迷ったようじゃ。

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_609_0.en: * You wouldn't mind walking me back to my study, wouldja?
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_609_0.ja:
＊ …よかったら　ワシの書斎まで
　 送ってくれんかの？

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_610_0.en: * Got something I gotta finish writing, y'see...
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_610_0.ja:
＊ もどって書かなきゃならんものが
　 あるんじゃ…

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_626_0.en: * Yeah, uh, no. We're kinda in a hurry here.
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_626_0.ja:
＊ …いや。悪りィけど
　 オレたち　急いでんだよ。

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_627_0.en: * We can't just babysit every random Darkner we meet.
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_627_0.ja:
＊ ダークナーのおもりとか
　 してる場合じゃねーんだわ。

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_629_0.en: * Ah, I see, I see. Good enough reason, that one.
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_629_0.ja:
＊ なるほど　なるほど。
　 そりゃ　ごもっともじゃわい。

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_680_0.ja: ＊ そんじゃ　オレらは…

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_682_0.ja:
＊ ところで　ダークナーとは
　 なんぞや？

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_711_0.ja: ＊ は？　じいさん　まさか…

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_721_0.en: * (Kris, if this guy's not a Darkner, then...)
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_721_0.ja:
＊ (おいクリス…　このじいさん
　 ダークナーじゃねえなら…)

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_747_0.en: * (Ugh, things'll get messy if he gets hurt!)
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_747_0.ja:
＊ (ほっとくと　危ねー目に
　 あったりして
　 やべーんじゃねぇのか！？)

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_748_0.en: * Fine! You can go with us. Just don't slow us down.
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_748_0.ja:
＊ わーったよ！
　 オレらと来てもいいけど　
　 ジャマだけは　すんなよ！

obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_750_0.en: * Hmm, alright, alright. You got it, little missy!
obj_ch4_DCA04_slash_Step_0_gml_750_0.ja:
＊ ふむ。よろしい。よろしい。
　 約束しよう　おじょうちゃん。

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_18_0.en: * (There is a distinct lack of steppable objects in that direction.)
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_18_0.ja:
＊ (その方向には
　 上に乗ることが可能な物体が
　 明らかに欠如している)

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_49_0.en: * Hmm... I've a mighty hankerin' to read a book. But I just can't reach...
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_49_0.ja: ＊ フム…　本が読みたくて 　 しかたがないんじゃが 　 手が届かんのう…

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_51_0.en: * Can it, old man. What's this look like, a library?
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_51_0.ja:
＊ あ？
　 じゃあ　図書館にでも
　 行けよ。

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_62_0.en: * Now, the hell do we get this open?
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_62_0.ja:
＊ てか　このドア
　 どうやって開けんだ？

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_151_0.ja: ＊ (上に乗れそうなイスを調べた)

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_202_0.en: * 'Scuse me, miss, wouldja mind helpin' me reach this book?
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_202_0.ja:
＊ おじょうちゃん　もしよかったら　
　 本を取るのを　手伝ってくれんかね？

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_204_0.en: * Not now, dude. I'm solving the door.
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_204_0.ja:
＊ いまムリ。
　 ドア解き中だ。

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_205_0.en: * Ralsei, help him reach the thing.
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_205_0.ja:
＊ ラルセイ　じいさんが
　 なんか言ってっから
　 手伝ってやれよ。

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_230_0.en: * There's something you can stand on right here!
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_230_0.ja:
＊ おじいさん　
　 ここに　ちょうどいい
　 踏み台が　ありますよ！

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_257_0.en: * Um, anyone, um... feel free to... step on me.
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_257_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_267_0.en: * Miss, I think I still need your help.
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_267_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_333_0.en: * Here, will you take this and -
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_333_0.ja:

　 ジャマすんなって言…

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_348_0.en: * Hey, the door opened! Let's go!
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_348_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_655_0.en: * (Hey, if I don't get to skip the puzzle, you don't either!)
obj_ch4_DCA05_slash_Step_0_gml_655_0.ja:
＊ (おい！　オレひとりに
　 考えさせんなよ！)

obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_17_0.en: * Oh, so you decided to come by? Thanks!
obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_17_0.ja:
＊ おや　やっぱり来てくれた。

obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_65_0.en: * You, um... haven't seen a shadowy figure, have you?
obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_65_0.ja:

　 ひと影のようなものを

obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_68_0.ja:
＊ 剣を持った何者かが　上のとびらへ

obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_84_0.en: * But, it's locked with some contraption.
obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_84_0.ja:
＊ じゃが　そのとびらは　
　 なんらかの仕掛けで

obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_85_0.en: * I reckon if you could get to the East Belltower, you might be able to open it...
obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_85_0.ja: ＊ 東の鐘塔に行けば　 　 ひょっとしたら　開けることが 　 できるかもしれんがのう…

obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_88_0.en: * Might help ya take your mind off it! It's that upper left door.
obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_88_0.ja: ＊ 左上の　とびらから行ける。 　 気晴らしに　行ってみては 　 どうかね？

obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_90_0.en: * (Yeah, like we're gonna waste time wandering around there...)
obj_ch4_DCA07_slash_Step_0_gml_90_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA08A_slash_Step_0_gml_76_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA08A_slash_Step_0_gml_77_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA08A_slash_Step_0_gml_87_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA08A_slash_Step_0_gml_88_0.ja: ＊ あとは　ピアノで弾けば…

obj_ch4_DCA08A_slash_Step_0_gml_90_0.en: * Yeah, unless there's, like, a third half.
obj_ch4_DCA08A_slash_Step_0_gml_90_0.ja:
＊ でも　３つめの半分とか
　 あるかもじゃね？

obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_42_0.en: * Amazing, Kris! You already knew the answer...
obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_42_0.ja:
＊ すごいよ　クリス！

obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_43_0.en: * ... You must really... know a lot of things, don't you.
obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_43_0.ja:
＊ クリスは本当に…
　 いろいろなことを
　 知っているんだろうね。

obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_57_0.en: * Amazing, Kris! You solved it without the second hint...
obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_57_0.ja:
＊ すごいよ　クリス！
　 ２つめのヒントがなくても
　 答えが　わかるなんて…

obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_58_0.en: * ... You must really... be an expert on the prophecy.
obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_58_0.ja:
＊ クリスは　本当に…
　 予言のエキスパート
　 なんだね。

obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_74_0.ja:
＊ 予言のとおりにしたら
　 全部　楽勝だったぜ。

obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_97_0.ja:
＊ 予言に書いてあること
　 かたっぱしからやってけば
　 余裕じゃね？

obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_98_0.en: * How about it, Ralsei. Wanna memorize it for us?
obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_98_0.ja:
＊ なあ　ラルセイ？
　 あそこに書いてあったこと　
　 全部　覚えといてくれよ。

obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_130_0.en: * ... umm, that's okay, Susie. I already know it.
obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_130_0.ja:
＊ …うん。大丈夫。
　 ボクは　もう　全部
　 知ってるから。

obj_ch4_DCA08B_slash_Step_0_gml_132_0.ja: ＊ おー　マジか。っしゃ。

obj_ch4_DCA08C_slash_Step_0_gml_67_0.en: * ... hey, Ralsei. If you know the whole prophecy already...
obj_ch4_DCA08C_slash_Step_0_gml_67_0.ja:
＊ …なあ　ラルセイ。
　 おまえ　予言　全部
　 知ってんだったらさ…

obj_ch4_DCA08C_slash_Step_0_gml_68_0.en: * ... why didn't you just say how to do the piano?
obj_ch4_DCA08C_slash_Step_0_gml_68_0.ja:
＊ さっきのピアノのパズルも
　 解き方　わかってたんだろ？
　 なんで　黙ってたんだよ？

obj_ch4_DCA08C_slash_Step_0_gml_70_0.en: * H-huh...? Well, I just thought...

obj_ch4_DCA08C_slash_Step_0_gml_71_0.en: * I just thought, isn't it better if I don't... say anything?
obj_ch4_DCA08C_slash_Step_0_gml_71_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　なにも言わないほうが
　 いいんじゃないかな
　 って。

obj_ch4_DCA08C_slash_Step_0_gml_148_0.en: * H-Hey, I think I found a light!
obj_ch4_DCA08C_slash_Step_0_gml_148_0.ja:
＊ …あ。見て！
　 明かりのスイッチ
　 見つけたかも！

obj_ch4_DCA08D_slash_Step_0_gml_233_0.en: * ... VERY WELL... IF YOU COME CLOASER TO THIS PLACE...
obj_ch4_DCA08D_slash_Step_0_gml_233_0.ja:
＊ …ワカった…
　 オマエたち　コッチ　クる…

obj_ch4_DCA08D_slash_Step_0_gml_235_0.ja: ＊ …オマエたちの　ホウへ　イくぞ…

obj_ch4_DCA08D_slash_Step_0_gml_441_0.en: * THE LAIGHT... NOT THE LAIGHT!!!!
obj_ch4_DCA08D_slash_Step_0_gml_441_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_148_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_150_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_151_0.en: * Ya mind deliverin' it for me?
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_151_0.ja: ＊ こいつを　届けてくれるかの？

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_179_0.en: * Like I said, when we wake up, it'll be gone, so...
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_179_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_181_0.en: * Yep, that's what I mean.

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_182_0.en: * This letter... just have a read of it for me.
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_182_0.ja:
＊ この手紙を…いま　ここで

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_183_0.en: * Then, when you wake up...
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_183_0.ja: ＊ あとで　目が覚めたときに…

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_184_0.en: * ... write it all back down, okay?
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_184_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_188_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_229_0.en: * ... Alright. Fine. I'll take a look.
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_229_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_260_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_261_0.en: * ... You sure you want ME to do it?
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_261_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_263_0.en: * Long as you got the point, the words don't matter.
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_263_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_301_0.ja: ＊ おお　そうじゃった　そうじゃった…

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_302_0.en: * ... mind telling your friend somethin' for me?
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_302_0.ja:
＊ …お友だちに　ワシからの伝言を
　 伝えてくれるかの？

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_330_0.en: * Hey, Kris, he asked if we ever looked at the fireplace...
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_330_0.ja:

　 「暖炉を調べたか」

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_331_0.en: * ... seems like... uh, a quest, thing? Up to you, though.
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_331_0.ja:
＊ …なんか　その…
　 クエスト？　的な？　
　 ま　おまえ次第だけどさ。

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_374_0.en: * ... see you later, old man!
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_374_0.ja: ＊ じゃ　またな　じいさん！

obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_392_0.en: * Alright, let's go get that fountain.
obj_ch4_DCA10_slash_Step_0_gml_392_0.ja:
＊ っしゃ！
　 待ってろ　闇の泉！

obj_ch4_DCA12_slash_Step_0_gml_60_0.en:
Why... Aren't they
stopping us from
sealing it...?
obj_ch4_DCA12_slash_Step_0_gml_60_0.ja:
ナイトは　どうして…
オレたちが　封印するのを
止めないんだろな…

obj_ch4_DCA12_slash_Step_0_gml_104_0.ja:
…ま　そのほうが
都合が　いいけどよ。

obj_ch4_DCA12_slash_Step_0_gml_115_0.ja:
うし…
クリス　頼んだぜ。

obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_91_0.en: * Guess the sun went down, huh...
obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_91_0.ja: ＊ すっかり　よるだな…

obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_102_0.en: * Damn, Kris! Look under the door!
obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_102_0.ja:
＊ クリス！　みろよ！
　 ドアの　した！

obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_103_0.en: * That weird smoke... no way...
obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_103_0.ja:
＊ この　くろい　けむり…
　 マジかよ…

obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_104_0.en: * You don't think... there's another Dark World!?
obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_104_0.ja:
＊ こんなかに
　 べつの　やみのせかいが
　 あるってことか！？

obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_105_0.en: * Damnit, that means the Knight is still...
obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_105_0.ja:
＊ てことは…
　 ナイトのヤロウは
　 まだ…

obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_133_0.ja: ＊ カギが　かかってやがる…

obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_134_0.en: * Ugh, it's a stupid numbers lock again!
obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_134_0.ja:
＊ クソッ　また
　 ばんごう　いれるヤツだ！

obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_157_0.en: * ... too hard to break, either.
obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_157_0.ja:
＊ …かたすぎて
　 こわすのもムリだな。

obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_159_0.en: * ... Guess we can try looking for the combination...
obj_ch4_DCA13_slash_Step_0_gml_159_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_190_0.ja:
＊ 特定の闇にしか

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_301_0.en: * If you KNOW something, why don't you just--
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_301_0.ja:
＊ 知ってることが

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_390_0.en: * I don't want... to say them. To... worry... you two.

＊ 言ったら　スージィと

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_391_0.en: * So I end up... I end up not saying... anything.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_391_0.ja:
＊ …結局いつも
　 なにも言えなくなっちゃうんだ。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_423_0.en: * What do you mean... You know so many things?
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_423_0.ja:
＊ いろんなこと知ってる…？
　 どういうイミだよ？

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_430_0.en: * About the "rules" of this world. About the prophecy.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_430_0.ja:
＊ この世界の「決まりごと」とか　
　 予言のこととか。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_431_0.en: * About... what the prophecy... says will happen.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_431_0.ja:
＊ 予言では…なにが起きると
　 言われているか…とか。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_432_0.en: * I didn't ask to know, but I do.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_432_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　知りたいなんて
　 言ってないのに…
　 知ってるんだ。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_467_0.en: * I... I'm sorry if it creeps you out!
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_467_0.ja: ＊ ゴメン…　気持ち悪いよね…！

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_468_0.en: * I'm sorry if I... don't tell you everything.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_468_0.ja:
＊ 全部を伝えられなくて…
　 ごめんね。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_469_0.en: * It's just... sometimes, knowing things...
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_469_0.ja:
＊ いろんなことを知ってるのって…
　 ときどき　すごく…

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_497_0.en: * And if anyone's going to hurt...
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_497_0.ja: ＊ つらい思いをするのは…

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_510_0.en: * Let it... just be me, okay?

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_548_0.en: * Oops, I... I'm sorry, haha, I... I...
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_548_0.ja:
＊ あは…あはは…
　 なんか　ごめん…
　 ボク…

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_585_0.en: * Is that... why you've been acting... so weird today?
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_585_0.ja:
＊ だから今日の　おまえ　
　 ずっと様子が

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_586_0.ja:
＊ だから　おまえは
　 ずっと…

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_588_0.en: * ... I... I've just been trying to stay ahead of you two.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_588_0.ja:
＊ …ボクは　ただ…
　 ２人よりも
　 先回りしたくて…

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_589_0.en: * So you don't have to see it. So you won't...
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_589_0.ja:
＊ そうすれば
　 見られなくてすむから…

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_590_0.ja: ＊ だって…見られちゃったら…

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_594_0.en: * The ending... of the prophecy.

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_596_0.en: * What, that... Last Prophecy thing...?
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_596_0.ja:
＊ 例の…「最後の予言」とかいう
　 ヤツか…？

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_632_0.en: * No, I mean, we almost did, but--
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_632_0.ja:
＊ いや。あとちょっとで
　 見えるとこだったけど…

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_641_0.en: * Please. Please let me go ahead from now on. Please.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_641_0.ja:
＊ お願い。お願いだから　
　 これからは
　 ボクに　先に行かせて。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_642_0.en: * I'll do every area. I'll do all the work.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_642_0.ja:
＊ 全部のエリアで　
　 なにもかも　ボクがやる。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_644_0.en: * You two can just hang out and... have fun!
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_644_0.ja:
＊ だから２人は…
　 ただ　楽しんで！

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_645_0.en: * I could do all the puzzles, I could...
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_645_0.ja:
＊ パズルも全部
　 ボクが　やるから…

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_666_0.en: * Hey... look. It's okay, man.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_666_0.ja:
＊ ラルセイ…
　 もういいって。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_667_0.en: * That Last Prophecy thing... I don't need to see it.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_667_0.ja:
＊ 「最後の予言」？
　 べつに　オレは
　 見なくたっていい。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_668_0.en: * So... if it helps, whenever you gotta...
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_668_0.ja:
＊ だからさ…
　 ラルセイが先に
　 行きたいときは…

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_669_0.en: * You can go ahead alone.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_669_0.ja: ＊ ひとりで　先に行けよ。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_671_0.en: * We're doing it together. As a team.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_671_0.ja:
＊ 全部いっしょにやろうぜ。
　 オレたち　チームだからな。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_688_0.en: * And NOTHING'S gonna change that.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_688_0.ja:
＊ なにがあっても
　 それは　ぜってー
　 変わらねえ。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_711_0.en: * Whether you like it or not, toothpaste boy!
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_711_0.ja:
＊ おまえがイヤだっつっても

　 ボーイ！

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_715_0.en: * Uhh, first noogie to make someone cry?
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_715_0.ja:
＊ いや… このゲンコツは
　 泣かすつもりのヤツじゃ
　 ねーんだけど…

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_751_0.en: * I'm just... glad you're friends with me.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_751_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　ただ…　スージィが
　 友だちでいてくれるのが
　 うれしくて。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_781_0.en: * I'll be more honest, Susie. I promise.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_781_0.ja:
＊ これからは　もっと　
　 本心を言うようにする。
　 約束だよ。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_782_0.en: * Even if it means... sounding... weird.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_782_0.ja:
＊ …言ったらヘンに
　 思われそうなときも。

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_785_0.en: * You couldn't get any weirder if you tried.
obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_785_0.ja:
＊ おまえは　もう　じゅうぶん

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_832_0.ja:
＊ それは　スージィも
　 いっしょでしょ！

obj_ch4_DCB02_slash_Step_0_gml_848_0.en: * ... well, let's get out of here, Kris.

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_163_0.ja:
＊ トリエルさんを　どこへ

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_164_0.en: * The Fountain's just past you, isn't it?
obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_164_0.ja:
＊ 闇の泉は　てめェの

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_189_0.en: * That means... we don't even have to beat you.
obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_189_0.ja:
＊ てことは…
　 てめェを倒す必要もねぇな。

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_190_0.en: * All we have to do is get PAST you... and it's over.
obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_190_0.ja:
＊ うしろに まわり込めば

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_192_0.en: * You can't beat us in the Light World, can you?!
obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_192_0.ja:
＊ 光の世界では
　 オレらを
　 倒せねぇんだろ！？

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_193_0.en: * That's... why you keep running, isn't it?
obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_193_0.ja:
＊ だから　そうやって
　 逃げ回ってんだよな！？

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_235_0.en: * Hey... hey, what's so funny?
obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_235_0.ja:
＊ なんだよ…

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_236_0.en: * Kris, why... are they laughing...?
obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_236_0.ja:
＊ クリス…　コイツなんで

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_237_0.en: * You're laughing 'cause you know I'm right, don't you!?
obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_237_0.ja:
＊ 図星だからだな？

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_275_0.ja:

＊ また　闇の泉を…？

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_486_0.en: * Wh... what is that thing!?
obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_486_0.ja: ＊ な…　なんだよ　アレ！？

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_553_0.en: * There's... there's no time to explain!!
obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_553_0.ja:
＊ いまは　説明してる

obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_554_0.en: * Everyone, climb on! It won't attack itself!!
obj_ch4_DCC01_slash_Step_0_gml_554_0.ja:
＊ みんな　登って！

obj_ch4_DCC02_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0.en: * ... hey Kris, what's the deal with that red heart thing...?
obj_ch4_DCC02_slash_Step_0_gml_78_0.ja:
＊ …なあ　クリス…
　 あの赤いハートのヤツ
　 なんなんだ…？

obj_ch4_DCC02_slash_Step_0_gml_79_0.ja: ＊ あれって　おまえの…

obj_ch4_DCC02_slash_Step_0_gml_100_0.en: * W-wait a sec! The old man!
obj_ch4_DCC02_slash_Step_0_gml_100_0.ja: ＊ いや…てか　じいさん！！

obj_ch4_DCC02_slash_Step_0_gml_101_0.en: * C'mon!! We... we still gotta talk to him!
obj_ch4_DCC02_slash_Step_0_gml_101_0.ja:
＊ まだ話したいことがある…！

obj_ch4_DCC02_slash_Step_0_gml_159_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCC02_slash_Step_0_gml_160_0.en: * I can't believe... it actually worked!

obj_ch4_DCC02_slash_Step_0_gml_161_0.en: * We... actually defeated a Titan...!

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_220_0.ja: ＊ 本当に　ごめんなさい…

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_272_0.en: * The hell are you apologizing for?
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_272_0.ja: ＊ な～に　あやまってんだよ？

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_273_0.en: * You're worried about THAT!? Seriously!?
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_273_0.ja:
＊ おまえが　心配してたのって

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_306_0.en: * Like something like that would happen.
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_306_0.ja:
＊ んなこと起きるわけ
　 ねぇじゃん。

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_312_0.en: * I wouldn't let it happen... Kris wouldn't let it happen...
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_312_0.ja:
＊ オレが　そうさせねぇし…

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_313_0.en: * And obviously YOU wouldn't let it happen.
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_313_0.ja:
＊ なにより　おまえが
　 そんなことに

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_359_0.ja: ＊ ほら　もう泣くなって。

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_360_0.en: * Everything's gonna be all right.

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_524_0.en: * I'm sorry I didn't say the whole prophecy at first.
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_524_0.ja:

＊ ボクたちが　みんなに

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_529_0.en: * Perhaps by the time we got here... it would change.
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_529_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_530_0.en: * But... but no matter what we do...
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_530_0.ja: ＊ だけど…なにを　どうやっても…

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_564_0.ja:

　 みたい。

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_586_0.en: * S-sorry... don't look at me... I...
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_586_0.ja:
＊ ゴメン…
　 ボクのことは　気にしなくて
　 いいから…

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_587_0.en: * I don't mean to always...
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_587_0.ja: ＊ ああ…　またやっちゃった…

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_588_0.ja:
＊ 自分のわがままで　
　 ひとに　気をつかわせて…

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_589_0.ja: ＊ ボクって　ホントに　ダメだね…

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_609_0.en: * Everything's OK, Kris. Look, I...
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_609_0.ja:

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_610_0.ja: ＊ ボク　笑ってるから！

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_672_0.ja:
＊ どんどん
　 むずかしくなっていくよ…

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_673_0.en: * To just stand there smiling all the time.
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_673_0.ja:
＊ …だまって笑顔で
　 いることが。

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_675_0.en: * Pretending I'm not afraid, too.
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_675_0.ja:
＊ 「ボクは　怖くない」って
　 顔してるのが。

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_678_0.ja:
＊ クリスとスージィと
　 いっしょに　いると…

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_680_0.en: * The more I'm with you two, I realize...
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_680_0.ja:
＊ いっしょにいる時間が
　 長くなるほど…

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_682_0.en: * About being happy all the time.
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_682_0.ja:
＊ いつも　いっしょに
　 笑顔で　いられるだけじゃ
　 ないって　わかってきて。

obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_683_0.en: * It's something far, far greater than I could've imagined...
obj_ch4_DCC03_slash_Step_0_gml_683_0.ja:
＊ ボクには想像もつかないぐらい

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_204_0.en: * Kind of like you're doing now.
obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_204_0.ja:
＊ ちょうど　いまの

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_207_0.en: * Kris, anyone tell you your family is goddamn weird?
obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_207_0.ja:
＊ クリス　おまえのかぞくって
　 やっぱ　すげーヘンだな。

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_284_0.en: * And here's a little something extra for your friend.
obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_284_0.ja:
＊ ムラサキのおともだちには

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_306_0.en: * If you need anything else, just holler.
obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_306_0.ja: ＊ それじゃ　ごゆっくり。

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_331_0.ja:
＊ せんとうモードぜんかいで

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_394_0.ja:
＊ トロすぎ！　じかんぎれだ！
　 ガハハ！

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_428_0.en: * So, guess we should get going, huh...?
obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_428_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_493_0.en: * Look, I made you talk.
obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_493_0.ja:
＊ みろ。
　 しゃべらせてやったぞ。

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_515_0.ja:
＊ オレは　そんなこと

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_533_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_544_0.en: * And then the rain fell down and...
obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_544_0.ja:
＊ …そこへ　あめが
　 ふってきてー…

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_553_0.ja: ＊ ぜーんぶ　きえましたとさ。

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_588_0.en: * I can never tell when you're messing around.
obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_588_0.ja:
＊ ジョーダンか　ホンキか

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_644_0.en: * You mind cleaning your place up a bit first, hon?
obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_644_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_646_0.en: * Huh? Ohh, uhhh, yeah, sure... heheh.
obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_646_0.ja:
＊ へ？　あ…ああ　だな…
　 ヘヘ…

obj_ch4_PDC05A_slash_Step_0_gml_682_0.ja:
＊ これでよし。
　 じゃ　いこうぜ。

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_89_0.ja:
＊ スージィ！　クリス！ 
　 おかえり！

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_92_0.en: * Yeah, yeah... hey, lemme talk about something.
obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_92_0.ja:
＊ へい　へい…
　 てか　話があんだよ。

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_130_0.en: * Remember that cop last night? Undyne...?
obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_130_0.ja:
＊ 昨日の夜　ナイトに
　 さらわれちまった警察官

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_131_0.en: * The Knight took her and locked her in the shelter south of town.
obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_131_0.ja:
＊ アンダイン署長な。あのあと
　 町の南のシェルターに

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_132_0.en: * We gotta get her out, but...the door's solid steel.
obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_132_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_133_0.en: * There's... no way we can break in.
obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_133_0.ja:
＊ 力ずくで　こじ開けんのは

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_134_0.en: * So now we're looking for the codes to the lock.
obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_134_0.ja:
＊ カギを　あけるには

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_135_0.en: * ... we thought Noelle's mom might have one, but...

＊ ノエルのママが

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_137_0.en: * Are you worried about her...? Undyne?

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_139_0.en: * Me? A cop like her? Hell no!

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_142_0.en: * Don't worry, Susie. Someone strong like her will be OK.
obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_142_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_143_0.en: * I want this place to be a place...

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_144_0.en: * Where you can forget about the real world for a while.
obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_144_0.ja:
＊ 現実の世界のことを

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_146_0.en: * And if anything tough happens,

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_147_0.en: * I'll come help you two, as fast as I can!

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_155_0.en: * They would have acted sooner, right?

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_156_0.en: * For now, let's make sure no one else gets taken.
obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_156_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_159_0.en: * ... heh, what's with you, making me feel better?
obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_159_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_255_0.en: * I wike you too, Suwsie!

obj_ch4_PDC06_slash_Step_0_gml_259_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_150_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_151_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_186_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_187_0.en: * You see this stupid excuse for a room?
obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_187_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_188_0.en: * I don't care what the reason is.
obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_188_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_304_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_305_0.ja:
＊ ふたりに　よろこんで

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_308_0.en: * I'm starting to feel like...

＊ 自分の意見を

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_310_0.ja: ＊ 自分が　好きなこととか…

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_311_0.ja:
＊ 自分が　イヤなこととかが
　 できてきて…

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_312_0.en: * My own desires. My own... fears.
obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_312_0.ja:
＊ 「望み」とか…
　 「恐れ」なんかも
　 抱くようになって。

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_357_0.ja:
＊ ダークナーは…こんな感情を
　 持っていて　いいのかな？

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_393_0.ja:

　 言ってもらえると…

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_413_0.ja: ＊ え？　いま　なんて言った？

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_414_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_415_0.en: * Ah, you're nodding! That means, um, yes, doesn't it?
obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_415_0.ja:
＊ あ。うなずいてるってことは…

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_417_0.en: * I'm sorry, Kris, I... I was being...
obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_417_0.ja:
＊ ごめんね　クリス…
　 ヘンなこと　聞い…

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_477_0.ja: (これ　もとの場所にもどして？)

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_482_0.en: * Alright, furniture piece number one!

obj_ch4_PDC06B_slash_Step_0_gml_484_0.ja: ＊ あ…りがとう　スージィ！

obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_66_0.en: * Now where the hell's Noelle?
obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_66_0.ja: ＊ ノエルのやつは　どこだ？

obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_84_0.en: * ... ugh, I'm gonna get hungry waiting around.
obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_84_0.ja: ＊ …まってると　はらがへるな。

obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_93_0.ja:

　 もってねぇ？

obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_120_0.ja:
＊ スージィ！　クリス！
　 いらっしゃい！

obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_132_0.en: * Sorry I'm late...! I just had to -
obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_132_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_157_0.en: * Um, is that a... a rose?

obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_159_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_190_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_214_0.ja: なに？　なに？　なに？？

obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_217_0.en: * No, it's fine! This way!
obj_ch4_PDC07_slash_Step_0_gml_217_0.ja:

obj_ch4_PDC08_slash_Step_0_gml_99_0.ja:

obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_141_.en:
* (You tossed the Manual hard.)

obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_144_.en:
* Umm...

obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_144_.ja:
＊ え…っと…
