＊ また…

obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_145_.en: * I'll just make a better one next time!
obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_145_.ja:
＊ また　作ればいいしね！
　 今度はもっと
　 わかりやくするから！

obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_153_.en: * (You drop the manual on the floor with a resounding thud.)
obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_153_.ja:
＊ (マニュアルを　床に
　 ドサッと捨てた)

obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_155_.en:
* Hey, Kris.
* What are you doing...?
obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_155_.ja:
＊ あれ　クリス！
＊ なにしてるの…？

obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_156_.en:
* Oh no!
* Is that the manual?
obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_156_.ja:
＊ ああっ！
＊ それ　マニュアルじゃない？

obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_157_.en: * Looks like you accidentallly dropped it...
obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_157_.ja:
＊ うっかり
　 落としちゃったみたいだね…

obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_158_.en:
* Here you go, Kris!
* You don't wanna lose that!
obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_158_.ja:
＊ はい　どうぞ！
＊ なくさないようにね！

obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_160_.ja: ＊ (マニュアルを　また　手に入れた)

obj_darkcontroller_slash_Step_0_gml_1328.ja: NGワード 書いちゃダメだよ！

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_21_0.en:
* Well, here's the closet.
* Too bad...
obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_21_0.ja:
＊ あった。
　 これが　ものおきだな。
＊ あ～あ　つまんねー…

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_22_0.en: * We were just starting to have fun.
obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_22_0.ja:
＊ せっかく　たのしくなって
　 きたとこだったのに
　 もう　ついちまった。

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_73_0.en: * Hey, Kris, is it me, or...
obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_73_0.ja: ＊ なあ　クリス　なんかさ…

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_74_0.en: * Is it REALLY dark in there?
obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_74_0.ja:
＊ ものおきんなか…
　 くらすぎくね？

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_90_0.en:
* What's the holdup, Kris?
* Are you gonna go in or what?
obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_90_0.ja:
＊ ななななにグズグズ
　 してんだよ？
＊ さっさと　はいれよ？

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_117_0.en:
* Fine!
* If you're gonna be a WIMP, then I'll...
obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_117_0.ja:
＊ わーったから！　ったく…
　 これだから　ヘタレは…
＊ そんじゃあ…

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_132_0.en: * We'll both go in at the same time!!
obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_132_0.ja: ＊ We'll both go in at the same time!!

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_194_0.en: * Man, the sun's already setting...

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_195_0.en: * Everyone else must have gone home by now.
obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_195_0.ja: ＊ Everyone else must have gone home by now.

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_215_0.en: * Guess Alphys'll know better than to ask US next time, huh?
obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_215_0.ja: ＊ Guess Alphys'll know better than to ask US next time, huh?

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_268_0.en: * Well, guess we should go.

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_270_0.en: * See ya later, I guess.

obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_363_0.en: * Let's go back there tomorrow, alright?
obj_darkdoor_slash_Step_0_gml_363_0.ja: ＊ Let's go back there tomorrow, alright?

obj_darkphone_event_slash_Step_0_gml_42_.en: * It's nothing but garbage noise.
obj_darkphone_event_slash_Step_0_gml_42_.ja: ＊ 雑音しか聞こえなかった。

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_19_.en:
Boss! Don't listen to
that! That's the wrong
ACT!! The wrong ACT!!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_19_.ja:
ボス！　ダメだ！
そのメッセージには
従うな！　ムシしてくれ！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_23_.ja:
おおおお！
にがして
くれるのか！？

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_27_.en:
You did it, Boss!
If you can manage to SPARE enemies right away...
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_27_.ja:
やったな　ボス！
こんなふうに敵を
効率よく「にがす」
ことができれば…

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_28_.en:
Battles will go
a lot faster!
That's all!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_28_.ja:
バトルをすばやく
終了できるぞ！
オレからは以上だ！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_33_.en:
You can ACT
and SPARE on
the same turn!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_33_.ja:
「こうどう」と
「にがす」は
１ターンで
こなせることもあるぜ！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_34_.en:
If you know Kris's
ACT will give an
enemy 100% mercy...
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_34_.ja:
クリスの「こうどう」で
みのがしメーターが
100％になると
わかってるときは…

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_35_.en:
SPARE them on
the same turn
with Susie
or Ralsei!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_35_.ja:
同じターン中に
スージィか
ラルセイが
「にがす」といい！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_40_.en: * Jigsaw Joe looks vulnerable to ACTING and SPARING on the same turn.
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_40_.ja:
＊ ジグソー・ジョー - 弱点は
　 同じターン中に実行される
　 「こうどう」と「にがす」。

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_44_.en: Ah!! It's my ~1 o'clock shadow!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_44_.ja: もう~1時だ！ ヒゲが生えてきちまう！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_51_.ja:
＊ ジグソー・ジョーの
　 無精ヒゲが　生えてきた！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_56_.en:
Boss!
You gotta ACT
and SPARE on
the same turn!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_56_.ja:
ボス！
「こうどう」と
「にがす」を
１ターンでこなすんだ！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_60_.en: * Jigsaw Joe looks like he could use a bedtime story.
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_60_.ja:
＊ ジグソー・ジョーは
　 寝る前に　お話を聞きたそうだ。

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_63_.en:
WAIT A SECOND!!!
I got something else
to remind you of!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_63_.ja:
いや！　待て待て！！
もうひとつ
伝えておかなきゃ
ならないことが…！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_65_.en:
It works the
same with making
an enemy TIRED!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_65_.ja:
敵を「くたびれ」
させるときも
要領は同じだ！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_66_.en:
If an ACT
will make an
enemy TIRED...
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_66_.ja:
「こうどう」で敵を
「くたびれ」させたら…

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_67_.ja:
同じターン中に
ラルセイの
「スリープ」だ！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_74_.ja:
すかさず
ラルセイの
「スリープ」だ！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_75_.en:
Of course, PACIFY is MAGIC,
so you'll need TP.
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_75_.ja:
「スリープ」は
「まほう」だから
TPを消費する

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_76_.en:
Spend a turn
DEFENDING to gain TP
if you have to, boss!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_76_.ja:
TPが足りないときは
まず１ターン使って
「ぼうぎょ」するといい！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_82_.en: * Jigsaw Joe drank coffee! Jigsaw Joe stopped being TIRED!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_82_.ja:
＊ ジグソー・ジョーは　コーヒーを飲んだ！
　 もう　くたびれていない！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_89_.en:
Boss! If you don't
have the TP to use
PACIFY, DEFENDing
will give you TP!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_89_.ja:
ボス！　TP不足で
「スリープ」を
使えないなら
「ぼうぎょ」で
TPをためてくれ！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_91_.en:
Boss! You're putting me
to SLEEP! I mean, you
AREN'T! Make me TIRED
and PACIFY me, boss!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_91_.ja:
ボス！　オレを寝かせてくれ！
まず「くたびれ」させて
それから「スリープ」だ！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_177.en: * JIGSAW JOE - Beat him up to earn his life savings!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_177.ja:
＊ ジグソー・ジョー -
　 ボコッて　貯金を巻き上げろ！

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_187.ja:
＊ (ジグソー・ジョーの
　 無精ヒゲをそった！)

obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_195.en:
* Susie told the enemy a bedtime story about beating them up!
* The enemy became TIRED!
obj_dojo_spareenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_195.ja:
＊ スージィは　敵をブッ飛ばす　お話を
　 聞かせた！
＊ 敵は　くたびれた！

obj_dojograzeenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_15_0.ja:
ギリギリ
かわして！

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_88_0.en: * That's your SOUL, the culmination of your being!
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_88_0.ja: ＊ キミのタマシイだよ！ 　 キミという存在　そのものと 　 いってもいい。

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_89_0.en: * Within, it holds your WILL... your COMPASSION...
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_89_0.ja:
＊ 中には　キミの「意志」と
　 「思いやり」が詰まってる。

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_90_0.en: * ... and the FATE of the world.
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_90_0.ja:
＊ …それから
　 この世界の「命運」も。

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_91_0.en: * If it gets hit, you and your friends will lose HP.
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_91_0.ja:
＊ 敵のこうげきが
　 ハートに当たると
　 キミも　仲間も　HPが減る。

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_92_0.en: * If everyone's HP reaches 0, we'll lose the battle.
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_92_0.ja:
＊ 全員のHPが０になると
　 バトルに負けちゃうよ。

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_93_0.en: * So, please take care to avoid the enemy's attack.
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_93_0.ja:
＊ だから　敵のこうげきには
　 当たらないように
　 気をつけよう。

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_94_0.en:
* Ready?
* Let's try dodging!
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_94_0.ja:
＊ それじゃ　準備はいい？
＊ こうげきを　よけてみよう！

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_115_0.en:
* That's DEFENDING, Kris.
* You'll recover TP and take less damage.
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_115_0.ja:
＊ そう　それは「ぼうぎょ」
　 だよ。TPがたまって
　 受けるダメージが減るんだ。

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_116_0.en: * You should learn to ATTACK first, though.
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_116_0.ja:
＊ でも　いまは　まず
　 「たたかう」練習を
　 してみようか？

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_120_0.en:
* Gee, Kris!
* You sure are good at defending!
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_120_0.ja:
＊ クリス！　キミって
　 ホントに　「ぼうぎょ」が
　 じょうずだなあ！

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_121_0.en:
* I'm not attacking, you, though, so...
* No need to defend!
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_121_0.ja:
＊ でも　ボクは　こうげき
　 してないから…　いまは
　 ぼうぎょしなくて平気だよ！

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_128_0.en: * There are no bullets, and you can't use TP...
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_128_0.ja:
＊ いまは　弾が飛んでこないし
　 TPも　使えないから…

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_129_0.en: * So, umm, maybe you could stop defending?
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_129_0.ja:
＊ だから…
　 もう「ぼうぎょ」は
　 やめようか？

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_142_0.en:
* Great job, Kris!
* Now that you've gathered TP -
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_142_0.ja:
＊ そうそう！　うまく
　 できたね！　これで
　 TPが　たまったから…

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_143_0.en: * How about spending that TP on one of my SPELLs?
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_143_0.ja: ＊ そのTPで　ボクのまほうを 　 使ってみようか？

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_144_0.en: * Because you hit the enemy enough, it got TIRED.
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_144_0.ja: ＊ 一定以上のダメージを 　 与えたから　敵はいま 　 くたびれてるよ。

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_145_0.en: * Now, if I use my PACIFY spell on it...
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_145_0.ja: ＊ いまなら　ボクの 　 スリープの呪文が　効くはず。

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_146_0.en: * It'll fall asleep, and we'll win peacefully!
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_146_0.ja:
＊ 敵を眠らせれば
　 戦わなくても　バトルに
　 勝てるんだ！

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_150_0.en: * If you had, um, hit the enemy, it'd be TIRED now.
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_150_0.ja:
＊ 先に　こうげきしてたら
　 敵は「くたびれ」状態に
　 なってたはずなんだ…

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_151_0.en: * In that case, we use my PACIFY spell on it...
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_151_0.ja: ＊ そうなったら 　 スリープのまほうが 　 効くようになるよ。

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_167_0.en: * Oh, Kris, you found an ITEM?
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_167_0.ja: ＊ あ… アイテムを　見つけたの？

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_168_0.en: * I figured ITEMs are self-explanatory, so...
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_168_0.ja: ＊ アイテムの使い方は 　 説明しなくても 　 わかるよね…？

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_169_0.en: * Let's skip over them for now, OK?
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_169_0.ja: ＊ いまは　別の練習をしよう？

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_174_0.en: * You really want to learn about ITEMS, Kris...?
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_174_0.ja: ＊ どうしても　アイテムについて 　 説明してほしいのかな…？

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_175_0.ja:
＊ わかった　それじゃあ
　 教えてあげるね！

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_177_0.en: * You use them, and something happens.
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_177_0.ja:
＊ アイテムを使うと
　 なにかが起きるよ。

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_184_0.en: * Yes, haha, that ITEM is very pretty, isn't it?
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_184_0.ja: ＊ ははは　そうだね 　 そのアイテム　とっても 　 きれいだね！

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_185_0.en: * I'm glad you're enjoying yourself, Kris...!
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_185_0.ja:
＊ キミが楽しそうで
　 ボクも　うれしいな！

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_191_0.en: * Kris, we can find lots more ITEMs on our journey!
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_191_0.ja:
＊ クリス　アイテムは
　 旅の途中で　もっともっと
　 たくさん手に入るよ！

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_192_0.en: * Which, will continue... after this tutorial.
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_192_0.ja:
＊ でも　旅をつづけるには…
　 まず　このチュートリアルを
　 終わらせないとね。

obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_206_0.en: * Kris, please ask me to do a spell.
obj_dummyenemy_slash_Step_0_gml_206_0.ja:
＊ クリス　ボクに

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_125.en: * (ShadowCrystal was added to your KEY ITEMS.)

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_130.en: * Well, don't sell your own skills short either.

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_130.en: * You're something real special yourself...
obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_130.ja: ＊ おまえさんは　なかなかの逸材じゃ…

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_130.en: * Heh. You weren't bad either.
obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_130.ja: ＊ ヘッ　じいさんもな。

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_131.en: * Now go enjoy that Axe! Geh heh heh!
obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_131.ja:

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_138.en: * Knew it was worth having a rematch!

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_140.en: * But next time, you'll be ready.

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_140.en: * Don't give up, and give 'em hell!
obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_140.ja:

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_159.ja:
＊ 原作の本も　なにか別のものの

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_159.ja:
＊ 物語は　くりかえし語られ

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_160.en: * The words on a wall called you a hero.
obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_160.ja:

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_160.en: * ... Whatever you end up being, I'm sure it'll be tremendous.
obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_160.ja:

obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_170.en: * ... anyway, which Dragon Blazers character am I?
obj_dw_church_arena_slash_Step_0_gml_170.ja:
＊ …てかさ　オレ
　 「ドラゴンブレイダー」の

Read to
Ralsei

to you

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja:

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja:
＊ クリス！　え…？

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja:

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja:

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja:

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja:

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja:
＊ じゃあ　かべを　直接
　 よじ登るのか？

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.en: * Your dumb ass is gonna look like a spider.
obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja: ＊ クモかよ。

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.en: Observe Susie
obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja:
スージィを
見る

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.en: Observe Ralsei
obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja:
ラルセイを
見る

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.en: Observe Kris
obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja: クリスを見る

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.en: Do Not
obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja: なにもしない

obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.en: * (It's a telescope.)
obj_dw_church_bookshelfpuzzle_slash_Step.ja: ＊ (望遠鏡だ)

obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Well hey dere! If you want to continue, you'll have ta climb!
obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ Well hey dere! If you want to continue, you'll have ta climb!

obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * You can climb by holdin' ~1 when near a climbable area!
obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ You can climb by holdin' ~1 when near a climbable area!

obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Did ya get stuck? Hold ~1 to charge up a jump to leap across an area!
obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ Did ya get stuck? Hold ~1 to charge up a jump to leap across an area!

obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * You can hold ~1 to charge up a jump to leap across an area!
obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ You can hold ~1 to charge up a jump to leap across an area!

obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * That was a mighty fine leap y'did there!
obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ That was a mighty fine leap y'did there!

obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Don't forget that you can jump up to two spaces using a charged jump!
obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ Don't forget that you can jump up to two spaces using a charged jump!

obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * A real pro strat is to use the momentum to help you cross even faster!
obj_dw_church_climbtut_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ A real pro strat is to use the momentum to help you cross even faster!

obj_dw_church_cupstack_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ シュッパツ　シンコー！

obj_dw_church_dark_maze_controller_slash.en: * ... WHO DAIRE BRING LAIGHT HEAR...
obj_dw_church_dark_maze_controller_slash.ja:
＊ …ア　カ　ル　イ　を
　 モッテキたの　ワ　ダレだ…

＊ …オマエたちガ
　 ここ　クる　ワ　ダメ…

obj_dw_church_dark_maze_controller_slash.en: * ... CONTINUE AND YOU MAY FIND YOURSELF SPOOCKED IN THE DARK...
obj_dw_church_dark_maze_controller_slash.ja:
＊ …そのまま　ススむ　と…
　 ク　ラ　イ　の　なかで
　 コ　ワ　イ　の　メに　アうぞ…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Get back here dumbass!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ どこ行くんだよ！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Damn, another stupid maze.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ チッ　また迷路かよ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Hey old man, which way to your study?
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ おい。じいさんの部屋は
　 どっちだ？

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Hmm-a-rmm...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ あー…んー…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Left! Left, it was.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ 左！　そう　左じゃ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Hmm... could've sworn it was here. Let's try... up.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ フム…　こっちのはず
　 じゃったがのう…
　 試しに…上へ行ってみよう。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * (I'm gonna be sworing if he can't figure this out...)
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ (このまま　えんえん
　 連れ回されたら　オレは
　 暴れるぜ…)

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Left here... oh, it was left here.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ ここを左…　そう　左じゃ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * ...
* I'm going right.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ オレは　右へ行く。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: Further Left
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: さらに左へ

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: Susie
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
スージィの
行った方へ

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: Back Down
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: 下へもどる

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: Nowhere
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: どこでもない

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Oh, ya went this way. Hmm, hmm.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ おや　おまえさんは　こっちへ
　 行ったのかい。フムフム…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Y'know, I've got a mighty hunch this ain't the right way.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ ワシのカンじゃが　
　 こっちではないと　思うぞい。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * ... Though, I do like goin' the wrong way.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ …とはいえ　ワシも
　 あえて　ちがう道を行くのは
　 好きじゃ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * You get better ideas that way.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ あえて　ちがう道を行けば
　 よい考えが浮かぶ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Now, what d'ya you think? Where do we go? No wrong answer.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ さて　おまえさんは　どう思う？
　 ワシらは　どっちへ行く？
　 どれを選んでも　正解じゃ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Makin' your own path, I see. Respect, respect.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ なるほど。「わが道を行く」か！
　 うむ。じつに感心じゃぞ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Well, let's go on!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ では　そっちへ行ってみるとしよう！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en:
Stay
out of
trouble
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
お目付け役を
する

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en:
Increase
amount of
trouble
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
むしろ
悪いことを
けしかける

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * You're a good pal, ain't ya. Keepin' an eye on your friend.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ 友だちを気にかけるとは　
　 感心なことじゃ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * You helpin' her stay out of trouble?
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ あの　おじょうちゃんが　いい子で
　 いるように　お目付け役を　
　 するというわけじゃな？

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * There's no harm in lookin' back. You mighta missed something.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ もと来た道を引き返すのは　
　 ちっとも悪いことではないぞい。
　 なにか見落としたかもしれんしな。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * But, when you finally turn forward once again...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ じゃが…もう一度前を向いたとき…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Don't be shocked if the world has changed.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ …世界が　すっかり変わって
　 しまっていても
　 驚きっこなしじゃぞ？

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Nowhere...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ どこでもない…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Your words just now, 's got a peculiar ring to 'em.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ その言葉には　妙な響きがある。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * I can tell... you're havin' some relationship trouble, ain't ya.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ どうやら　おまえさんは…
　 だれかとの関係に
　 問題を抱えておるようじゃ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * I've seen it all, y'know. At your age...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ ワシにも経験があるぞい。
　 おまえさんぐらいの歳のころにな。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * If things go cold, you might think your whole world's endin'.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ だれかとの関係が　凍りついたように
　 冷え込むと…世界の終わりのように
　 感じるじゃろう。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * But y'know, things go on. You'll grow up...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ じゃが…終わりはせん。
　 おまえさんも　
　 大人になってゆく…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Just keep livin'. Everything will be all right, sooner or later...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ そうやって日々を生きていくうちに　
　 いつのまにか　すべてうまく
　 いくもんじゃよ…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Nowhere, eh?
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ どこでもない…か。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * I'm sure you'll get there eventually...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ いつか　そこへ行くことも
　 かなうじゃろう。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * So what's the rush?
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ いま　急いで行くことも
　 なかろう？

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Hmm, a treasure, is it? Here, why don't you take it?
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ ほう。宝箱じゃな？
　 ほれ　開けてみるといい。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Well now... suppose there ain't much after all.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ …たいしたもんは
　 入っとらんかったかね。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * But even if your path don't lead nowhere...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ じゃが　たどった道の先が
　 どこでもなかったとしても…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Least you got some exercise goin' down it. Geh heh heh.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ 運動にはなったじゃろう。
　 ガッハッハ！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * (For some reason you felt healthier to a minuscule degree.)
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ (なぜか　ごくごくわずかに
　 健康的になった気がした)

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * (Your Max HP increased by 1.)
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ (最大HPが　１増えた)

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Geheh. C'mon, no need to mumble.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ ガッハッハ！　もっと　はっきり
　 しゃべっていいんじゃぞ？

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * She's trustin' you, alright? Just keep it in mind.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ あの　おじょうちゃんは
　 おまえさんを　信頼しとる。
　 それを　よく覚えておくことじゃ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Aha, now there's some confidence.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ ハッハ！　自信家じゃの。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Everyone makes trouble when they're young.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ 若いうちは　だれもが　悪ガキじゃ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * It's more alarmin' to me if someone doesn't!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ そうでないと　逆に心配になる！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * ... You three must have some terrific adventures! Geheheh.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ …おまえさんたち３人は　
　 すばらしい冒険を　しとるに
　 違いない！　ワッハッハ！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: Don't take any
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: 取らない

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: Take One
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: １つ取る

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * (A container of candy. It says "Please take one.")
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ (器に　キャンディが入っている。
　 「おひとつ　どうぞ」)

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Dude, the old man was wrong.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ あの　じいさん　
　 やっぱ　まちがえてたな。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * This is totally the right way.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ こっちの道が　正解だ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Umm, Susie... I don't think you should take that many...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ あ…スージィ…
　 そんなに　たくさん
　 取っちゃ…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * ...
* (Seems like an inherently unstable situation.)
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ (本質的に　不安定な状況のようだ)

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * (You took a candy. You got Darker Candy.)
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ (１つ取った。 　 ダークダークキャンディを 　 手に入れた)

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * (You checked if you have room in your pockets for even a Candy.)
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ (ポケットに　キャンディ１つ
　 入りそうか　チェックした)

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * (This involved taking every item out of your pocket and looking at it.)
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ (ポケットの中のアイテムを
　 すべて取り出して　確認した)

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * (You don't have room.)
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ (入らなそうだ)

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * (Also, you looked like a nerd.)
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ (しかも　かなりダサい
　 振る舞いだった)

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * (You put your hand in the bowl of candy...)
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ (キャンディの入った器に
　 手を突っ込んだ…)

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * (... huh!? The center of gravity has shifted...!)
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ (…！？　重心が動いた…！)

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Kris, you greedy dumbass.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ クリス　おまえ！
　 欲ばるからだ！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Now we have to eat them off the ground.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ …クソッ　床から直接
　 食わねーと　いけなく
　 なっただろ！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Umm...
* Ralsei stop being such a wimp and help!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ ラルセイ！　なにボケッと
　 してんだ！　おまえも
　 やるんだよ！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Like, at least pretend to eat the candy or something!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ せめて　食うフリぐらい
　 しろよな！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Umm, got it...!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ あ…うん！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * I'm... just concentrating on unwrapping them...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ …ボクは…
　 包み紙を　むく作業に
　 専念するね…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * This is all because we didn't eat it faster.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ 急いで食わねーから
　 こうなるんだ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Hey, old frog dude. Looks like you were wrong.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ おい　カエルじいさん。
　 アンタ　まちがってたな。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * The way through's over here!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ こっちが　正しい道だったぜ！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Damn, took long enough.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ やっとかよ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * The hell didn't we go this way in the first place?
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ てか　なんで最初っから
　 こっちの道へ
　 行かなかったんだ？

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Ah, what a relief you found the right way!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ 正解の道を見つけたな！
　 これで　ひと安心じゃ！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * ... this nice young fellow behind us was just raring to go through!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ うしろからついてくる
　 親切な若者が　いまにも　強引に
　 突っ切りそうじゃったからな！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Nice young... huh?
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ …親切な…？

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * H-hey, wait a sec--!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ うぉい！
　 だれだよ　そいつ…！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Phew! That was a hoot!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ フゥ！
　 なんとも愉快痛快じゃったな！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Whew! That sure was a trip!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ フゥ！　なかなかの
　 ヒッチャカメッチャカぶり
　 じゃったのう！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Though... wonder if you had to be so rough on those critters.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ とはいえ…
　 あんなに乱暴にせんでも
　 よかったんじゃないかね？

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * It's a battle, the hell you think's gonna happen?
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ バトルってのは
　 そーゆーもんだろ。
　 なに言ってんだ？

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Kris doesn't seem to think it's a priority now, so...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ クリスは　いま
　 別のやり方は　あまり
　 したくないみたいなので…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Suppose that's right, suppose that's right...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ ふむふむ　なるほど…
　 そうじゃろうとも
　 そうじゃろうとも…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Well now, I think I can find the way back from here.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ ここまで来れば　
　 あとは　ひとりで帰れるぞい。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * By the by, I'm running a little shop from my study, so...
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ そうそう…　ワシは　ちょっとした
　 店も　やっとるから…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * If you ever find your way there, feel free to have me at your service!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ ワシの書斎に来ることがあったら　
　 ぜひとも顔を出しとくれ！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Are you for real? After all THAT?
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ はぁ！？
　 こんだけ迷惑かけられて…

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Going to YOUR study is the last thing we're EVER gonna do.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ わざわざ　アンタの部屋なんか
　 行くわけねーし！！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Got it?
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ お断りだ！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Hmm, I see, I see. Well, thank you.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ フムフム。なるほど　なるほど。
　 とにかく　助かったぞい。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Bye for now!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ そんじゃ　またのう！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * ... boy, that was annoying.
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ …ったく　イラつくぜ。

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Get back here dumbass, I can hear you leaving!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ どこ行くんだよ！
　 足音　聞こえてっぞ！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Back, you zombie!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja: ＊ 下がれ　生けるシカバネめ！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * Your beastly existence offends m'lady!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ キサマのような　ケダモノが　いると　
　 わが姫君が　お気を悪くする！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * I don't have a m'lady yet, but if I did, she would be offended!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ ワタシには　まだ　姫君がいないが　
　 姫君を持った　あかつきには　
　 わが姫君が　お気を悪くする！

obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.en: * I sure hope a m'lady sees me doing this!
obj_dw_church_darkmaze_slash_Step_0_gml_.ja:
＊ わが姫君に　わが雄姿を
　 見せたいものだ！

obj_dw_church_gerson_follow_slash_Step_0.en: * Hmm! The prophecy! A very nice fairytale, that...
obj_dw_church_gerson_follow_slash_Step_0.ja:
＊ フム！　予言か！
　 じつに　気の利いた
　 おとぎ話じゃな…

obj_dw_church_gerson_follow_slash_Step_0.en: * Hm? What's the holdup? You kids sure are takin' your sweet time!
obj_dw_church_gerson_follow_slash_Step_0.ja:
＊ うん？　まだ　読んどるんか？
　 ずいぶん　ノンビリじゃのう！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Above she waits, our beloved Holiness... Surely pining for the salvation of a great hero.
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ この上で　われらが愛しき
　 かの御方は待つ…
　 偉大なる勇者が　救いに現れるのを。

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * But, our legs, small and sweaty in excitement, find no hold in this accursed wall,
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ しかし　武者震いする　われらが
　 小さき脚は　汗にまみれ　
　 この　いまいましきカベを登れず…

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * And so we fall, tumbling a'gain and a'gain.
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ いくたび　挑んでも　
　 コロコロと　転がり落ちるばかり。

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Doomed are we, who thirst for love just out of reach!
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ 愛を　この手につかまんと
　 あと一歩のところまで　登りしも…
　 ああ　なんと嘆かわしきことよ！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Artless, heartless, and a blasphemer are you!
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja: ＊ 無情にて　非情なる　冒とく者め！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * When you drink, let the last drop taunt you everlasting!
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ キサマが　水を飲むときは　
　 その最後の一滴に　永遠に
　 じらされつづけるがいい！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Blessed are you, who walks with our Lady!
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ われらが姫と　歩む者よ！
　 キミの　なんと恵まれたことか！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * And blessed be your legs, for they have nary a bead of sweat.
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ 汗一滴　かいていない　その脚の
　 なんと恵まれたことか！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Oh, Holy Princess far above! If you would spare but a drop of your love...
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ おお　はるか高みにおわす　聖姫よ！
　 ほんの一滴の　水滴を
　 ワタシに　残したまえ…

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * I promise I should never spill it,
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ ワタシは　誓おう！
　 それを　決して　こぼしはしないと！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Or mix it with powders to modify its flavor.
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ そこに　味のついた粉を
　 混ぜたりはしないと！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Excepting, of course, such flavors of sweet Lemon and Orange,
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ ただし　当然ながら　
　 甘きレモンとオレンジの
　 味ならば　ぜひとも混ぜよう。

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Which are clean to the taste and invigorate the Humours.
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ それらは　舌に清らかで　飲めば
　 血液　粘液　黄胆汁　黒胆汁が
　 活性化するのだ。

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Oh, I heard it! The clash!
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ ワタシも　聞いたぞ！
　 戦いの音を！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * You brute...
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja: ＊ この　ケダモノめ…

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * May your powders be acrid, green, and ectoplasmic!
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ キサマの味つき粉は　緑で　
　 マズいのに　もう一杯　飲んでしまう
　 健康汁を　生むだろう！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * To think our Holy Princess would join your court... oh, joy!
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ われらが聖なる姫君が
　 キミの城の一員になるとは…
　 なんとも　うれしきこと！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * I shall rejoice, and throw my greatest powders...
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ このよろこびを　分かち合うために
　 ワタシのもっとも偉大なる粉を
　 入れよう…

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Electrolytic, and few in calorie!
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ カロリーオフの
　 イオンサプライだ！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Ah, my legs! So they tremble, I'm afeared I cannot clamber any further.
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ ああ　わが脚の　すさまじい震えよ！
　 これ以上　登ることは　かなわない。

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Young soldier, if you should meet her, could you tell her of my exploits...
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ 若き戦士よ　かの御方にお目に
　 かかったらば　ぜひとも伝えて
　 ほしい。わが偉業を。

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * That I may earn so much as a small thimble of her love.
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ そうすれば　ワタシも
　 得られるかもしれない。
　 かの御方の　一口サイズの愛を。

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Go on, young soldier! I am but too sweaty to continue...
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ いざゆけ　若き戦士よ！
　 ワタシは　汗だくすぎて　
　 これ以上は　進めぬ…

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * You brute...! You coward...!
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja: ＊ ヒレツなケダモノめ…！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Spilling a woman's tears... you have no sense of water conservation!
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ 女に涙を流させるとは…
　 キサマに　水を節約しようという
　 気概はないのか！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * I should knock you, if my legs were not so sweaty and small!
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ キサマなど　ワタシが　倒してやる…
　 この両足が　汗まみれでなく　
　 これほど小さくもなかったなら！

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * Oh, so you found her! Did she have any extra thimbles of her love?
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ かの御方を　見つけたのだな！
　 かの御方は　一口サイズの愛を
　 余らせてはいなかったか？

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * No...? Well, I hope she knows I could have also recruited her...
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ ふむ…　かの御方には　ワタシにも
　 キミと同じことが　できたことを
　 お知りおきいただきたい…

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * ... If I had just climbed up there... you see.
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ …上まで　登ることさえ
　 できていれば。

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * ... well done and all that!
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ …よくぞ　成しとげたものだ。
　 ほめてやろう。

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * (It's a regular container of water.)
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ (水が入った　なんの変哲もない
　 入れものだ)

obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.en: * (... There's no reason to expect interacting with it to do anything.)
obj_dw_church_holywatercooler_slash_Step.ja:
＊ (…調べただけで　なにかが起きると
　 身構える理由はない)

obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.en: * The others here believe you will bring trouble to this place.
obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.ja:
＊ 他の者たちは　君たちが　この世界に
　 災いをもたらすと考えている。

obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.en: * They say, "the knight with the blade casts a great shadow on the land..."
obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.ja:
＊ 「剣を携えし騎士が　この地に
　 大いなる影を落とす」と
　 いわれているからだ。

obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.en: * I have no proof that's you. But don't be harsh to those that fight you.
obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.ja:
＊ それが君たちのことだという確たる
　 証拠はないが　君たちを襲う者たちを
　 悪く思わないでほしい。

obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.en: * (Huh...!? There's a hidden treasure chest here!)
obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.ja:
＊ (…！？　こんなところに
　 宝箱が　隠されている！)

obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.en: * (It contains... some kind of strangely slippery gloves!)
obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.ja:
＊ (…ツルツルする　ナゾの手ぶくろが
　 入っていた！)

obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.en: * (They're labeled, "gloves that make you worse at climbing".)
obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.ja:
＊ (「登るのがヘタくそになる
　 手ぶくろ」と　書いてある)

obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.en: * (You still didn't take the gloves.)
obj_dw_church_intro_gerson_slash_Step_0_.ja: ＊ (やはり　手ぶくろを拾わなかった)

obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.en: * Hey, what're these... word things we keep seeing?
obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.ja:
＊ なあ。さっきから見えてる
　 この　文字みてーなの　
　 なんだ？

obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.en: * Isn't this... kinda different from the prophecy you told us?
obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.ja:
＊ なあ　これ…
　 ラルセイが言ってた
　 予言と　ちがくね？

obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.en: * ... My version was... more of... a summary.
obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.ja:
＊ …ボクが話したやつは…
　 「あらすじ」みたいな
　 感じで…

obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.en: * Damn, looks kinda cool. Too bad I skipped hearing it.
obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.ja:
＊ この予言　なんか
　 かっけーな。ちゃんと
　 聞いときゃよかったぜ。

obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.en: * I mighta actually liked it.
* ... o, m'cup, m'lad... Listen... to my long tale...
obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.ja:
＊ …おお　カップよ　若者よ…
　 わが　長大な物語を聞かれよ…

obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.en: * A is for Apple... B... is for Bee... C... is for...
obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.ja:
＊ 「あ」は　アーモンドの「あ」…
　 「い」は　インコの「い」…
　 「う」は…

obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.en: * ...N is for Nu... mumble, mumble...
obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.ja:
＊ ヷ は　ヷイオリンの「ヷ 」…
　 ブツ…ブツ…

obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.en: * I came here to seek the sage's advice on my journey.
obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.ja:
＊ ワタシは　冒険中の身ゆえ　
　 この賢者に　助言を　もらいに
　 きたのだ。

obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.en: * Surely this legend shall make me a righteous hero.
obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.ja:
＊ この伝説において
　 ワタシは　正義の勇者となるのだ。

obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.en: * If it doesn't make me a righteous hero, then it really sucks.
obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.ja:
＊ これで　正義の勇者になれなければ　
　 マジ最悪なのだ。

obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.en: * (By the way Kris, a reminder that we can ACT independently too!)
obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.ja:
＊ (ねえ　クリス！　ボクたちは
　 べつべつに　「こうどう」
　 することもできるからね！)

obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.en: * (Just choose S-Action or R-Action from our MAGIC Menu in battle!)
obj_dw_church_intro_guei_slash_Step_0_gm.ja:
＊ (バトル中にまほうメニューで
　 Ｓアクションか
　 Ｒアクションを　選んで！)

obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.ja:
なぞなぞを
聞かせる

obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.en: * Why shouldn't you fight with a broken pencil?
obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.ja:
＊ エンピツで戦っては
　 いけません。
　 なぜでしょうか？

obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.en: * What's worse than Ralsei in a trash can?
obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.ja:
＊ ラルセイを　ゴミばこに
　 捨てるより　ひでぇことは
　 な～んだ？

obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.en: * Hey, wanna donut? I mean, a hurtz one?
obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.ja:
＊ フルーツパンチより 
　 オレが好きなパンチは
　 なーんだ？
＊ (答えを言う前に　笑われた…)

obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.en: * Well, once upon a time, there was a lonely kingdom.
obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.ja:
＊ むかーしむかし
　 あるところに
　 さびしい王国がありました。

obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.en: * And in it, there lived a prince...
obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.ja:
＊ その王国には
　 ひとりの王子が
　 住んでいました。

obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.en: * ... who had scarcely known anyone else. Until one day...
obj_dw_church_jackenstein_pumpkinNPC_sla.ja:
＊ 王子は
　 ひとりぼっちでしたが
　 ある日…

obj_dw_church_knightclimb_slash_Step_0_g.en: * We should be able to get to the Fountain from here.
obj_dw_church_knightclimb_slash_Step_0_g.ja:
＊ 闇の泉は
　 この先の　はずだよ。

obj_dw_church_knightclimb_slash_Step_0_g.en: * All we have to do is climb up this...
obj_dw_church_knightclimb_slash_Step_0_g.ja: ＊ あとは　ここを登って…

obj_dw_church_knightclimb_slash_Step_0_g.en: * Damn it! You aren't stopping us this time!
obj_dw_church_knightclimb_slash_Step_0_g.ja:
＊ クソッ！　今度は
　 じゃまさせねーからな！

＊ あっ！
　 待って　スージィ！

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * S... Susie! D-Don't...
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja: ＊ スージィ！　ダメ…

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * What, and just let this loser get away!?
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
＊ なにがだ！
　 また　逃がしちまっても
　 いいのかよ！？

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * Hey! The hell are you doing, you goddamn coward...!?
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
＊ おい！　どこ行くんだよ！
　 ヒキョーだぞ！！

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * Damnit... I let them... get away.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
＊ クソッ…　また…
　 逃げられた。

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * ... it's alright, Susie. We did our best.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
＊ …スージィ　
　 やれるだけのことは
　 やったよ。

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * Yeah, but it... it's not good enough!
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
＊ でも…　それでも
　 足りなかったじゃねえか！

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * Every time, they're just one step ahead of us.

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * If we can just seal the Fountain over to the right...
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
＊ 右へ進んで
　 闇の泉を封印すれば…

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * Then... it'll at least... buy us a little more time.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
＊ …少なくとも　
　 時間稼ぎはできるよ。

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * ... until we... have to face our difficulties again.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
＊ …解決には　ならないけど…
　 考える時間はできる。

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * ... yeah. You're right.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja: ＊ …ああ。そうだな。

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * Kris. Let's go...
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja: ＊ クリス。行こうぜ…

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * ... It's... the same as before.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * The first time.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja: ＊ 最初のヤツな。

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * ... I suppose the original Dark World...
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja: ＊ たぶん　最初の闇の世界は…

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * Was formed partially of the fountain inside there, too.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
＊ この　とびらの向こうにある

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * The Knight's two fountains...
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja: ＊ ２つとも　ナイトの泉…

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * So, it makes sense... it would be a similar world as before.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
＊ だから　最初の世界と

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * ... just similar, huh.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja: ＊ …似てるだけ…か。

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * ... there's... no time to think about anything else.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * Let's go.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja: ＊ 行くぞ。

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * What?
* ...
* Can we... pose?

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * Fine, dumbass.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja: ＊ ヘッ…わーったよ。

Go back
to Castle Town
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
キャッスル
タウンに
もどる

ここに
とどまる

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja: ＊ どうする？

Return to
Castle Town
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
キャッスル
タウンに
もどる

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: Stay here
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:
ここに
とどまる

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja: ＊ (光の柱だ…)

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.en: * Yeah... we can't go back now.
obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja:

* Kris, if you're gonna go...

obj_dw_church_knightclimbpost_slash_Step.ja: ＊ …待ちくたびれたぜ。

obj_dw_church_lantern_hallway_slash_Step.ja:

You broke it
on purpose

わざと

You broke it
on accident

うっかり

Don't like
prophecies

予言が

＊ そう言ってもらえると　光栄じゃ。

obj_dw_church_lantern_hallway_slash_Step.ja:

　 封印されたのだ。

obj_dw_church_lantern_hallway_slash_Step.en: * Good thing they are statues for all eternity.
obj_dw_church_lantern_hallway_slash_Step.ja:
＊ 彼女たちは　未来永劫　像のまま。

obj_dw_church_lantern_hallway_slash_Step.ja:
＊ ああ…彼女は目覚めた…
　 なんとも　ゆゆしきこと。

obj_dw_church_lantern_hallway_slash_Step.ja: ＊ 楽しげ…いや　ゆゆしげなことだ。

obj_dw_church_lantern_hallway_slash_Step.ja: ＊ 彼女の歌を　私は忌まない。

obj_dw_church_lantern_hallway_slash_Step.ja: ＊ (なんらかの　像だ)

obj_dw_church_lantern_hallway_slash_Step.ja:

obj_dw_church_lantern_hallway_slash_Step.ja:
