scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: It can be used to make calls.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: 電話を　かけられる。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: Cell Phone
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: ケータイ

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: Not too important, not too unimportant.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
そんなに大事じゃないし
それほど大事じゃないわけでもない。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: Egg
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: タマゴ

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Though broken, it seethes with power.
A master smith could fix it.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
壊れてもなお　すさまじい気を発するケーキ。
鍛冶職人なら直せるだろう。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: BrokenCake
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: こわれたケーキ

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
It's the top part of a key.
A smith could fix all three parts.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
カギのいちばん上の部分。パーツを3つ
集めれば鍛冶職人が直してくれる。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: Broken Key A
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: こわれたカギＡ

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
The key to a mysterious cell.
Something feels strange about it.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ナゾのろう屋のカギ。
どこか怪しい雰囲気がただよう。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: Door Key
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: とびらのカギ

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
It's the middle part of a key.
A smith could fix all three parts.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
カギの真ん中の部分。パーツを3つ
集めれば鍛冶職人が直してくれる。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: Broken Key B
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: こわれたカギＢ

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
It's the bottom part of a key.
A smith could fix all three parts.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
カギのいちばん下の部分。パーツを3つ
集めれば鍛冶職人が直してくれる。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: Broken Key C
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: こわれたカギＣ

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Hohoho! I'm a tough boy!
Treat me like one of your ITEMS!
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ホッホッホ！　ボクさまは　じょうぶな子だ！
アイテムあつかいしてくれて　けっこうだぞ！

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Hohoho! ROUXLS jumped out of your
pocket! How dadcrobatic! (Lesser)
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ホッホッホ！　ルールノーはポケットから
(サブ)パパッと飛び出したゾ！

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Hohoho! That game looked fun!
Let me be the stool next!
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ホッホッホ！　楽しそうなゲームだったぞ！
次は　ボクさまが　イスやる番！

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Sounded like milk out there. Splat!
Were you three osmosing without me!?
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ミルクっぽい　ペチャッって音がしたぞ！
さてはナイショで　ミルクを吸収してたな！？

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
We fell! But don't worry. I'm a strong boy.
I won't be trounced by a mere bounce!
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ボクさま　とっても丈夫なコ！
落ちてもヘッチャラ　無傷だヨ！

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Split up? We'll solve this mystery fast!
You? You can be the un-talking dog.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ふた手に分かれて　事件を解決！
こっちは　だまって　モクモク前進！

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Ho-ho! A soft cream is following you!
Can we make them a bad guy?
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ホッホッホ！　ソフトクリームが仲間になった！
そいつは　悪モノになってくれるかな？

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
That golden statue... Could it be...
The illusory nipple technique!?
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
あの黄金の像…　あれはおそらく…
疑似乳首法で製作されたものだぞ！

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Wow! Thanks for the free sample!
I couldn't eat another bite!!
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
無料のサンプル　うれしいな！
もう　ひと口も　食べられない！

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
The bluebird of crappiness.
Fly high, bluebird. Fly high.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ショボッショボの　青いトリ。
飛べ　飛べ　空高く！

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Did I miss something? I was doing my
calisthetics. Stay handsome.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ボクさま　なにか見逃した？
自重トレーニング中で見てなかったぞ。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Hey! Thanks for the tape! I was hungry!
Push my tummy to hear a cool song!
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
テープを食べて　おなかいっぱい！　ボクさまの
おなかを押してみて！　音楽が流れるヨ！

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Hoho! It's me, Lancer! Release me and
I will release you!
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ホッホッホ！　ボクさまを自由にしてくれたら
自由にしてあげちゃうぞ！

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: (Innocent boys are fast asleep.)
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
(無垢な少年たちは
ぐっすり眠っている)

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
A stone statue.
Strangely, it looks like Lancer...
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
石の像。
なぜかランサーに似ている…

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Hoho! What a terrific boy's adventure.
Time to kick off my feet and relax...
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ホッホッホ！　なんてスバラシイ冒険少年体験！
アンヨを伸ばして　のんびりするぞ…

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Oo la la! Who is that handsome
mustachioed boy! I think I'm in love!
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ウ～ララ～！　おヒゲが　ステキな　あの少年！
ボクさま　恋に落ちちゃいそう！

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
(huff, puff) There, I got back into your
pocket! Now you can use my power!
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
(ひぃ…ふぅ…)おまえのポッケに　もどったぞ！
ボクさまのパワー　いつでも使ってOKだ！

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: Lancer
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: ランサー

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Thou gazeth upon a man most handsometh.
This daringst genius, adoredeth beyondth all hey let me speakst
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
なんじの見るはまことのイケメン。豪胆なる鬼才
にして天が下の民草より崇めあ待ってまだ続きが

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: Rouxls Kaard
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: ﾙｰﾙﾉｰ･ｶｧﾄﾞｰ

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Oh, milord! Tis I, your humblest servante,
righte here where I never lefteth!
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
やや！　余は我が君の　忠実なる僕。逃げたり
なんて　しておらズ　ずーっといましたけど？

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
A data disk from a strange machine.
Didn't someone want this?
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ナゾのマシンから手に入れたデータ保存用
ディスク。だれかが欲しがっていたような…

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: EmptyDisk
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: ﾌﾞﾗﾝｸﾃﾞｨｽｸ

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
A strange disk. You can feel it
smiling in your hand.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ナゾのディスク。
手に持つと　ほほ笑みの感触が伝わってくる。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: LoadedDisk
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: ﾃﾞｰﾀﾃﾞｨｽｸ

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
A shady-looking program that can
open certain doors.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
怪しげなプログラム。
あるとびらのカギを開けることができる。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: KeyGen
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: キー生成キ

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: A sharp shadow moves like water in the hand. You have collected [~1].
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: 手のなかで　するどい影が　水のように うごめく。~1 個入手済み。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: ShadowCrystal
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: シャドウジェム

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: Starwalker
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: スターウォーカー

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
The original                     
         (Starwalker)
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
オリジナルの                     
         (スターウォーカー)

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: PureCrystal
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: ピュアジェム

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: The shadow purified by the cat
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: とあるネコの力で　闇の要素が浄化されている

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: OddController
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: コントローラー？

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
A gamepad no one wanted to use.
The buttons are an ugly pink and yellow.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
だれも使いたがらないコントローラー。
ボタンは趣味の悪いピンクと黄色。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: BackstagePass
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: VIP用パス

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
A pass for big shots allowed backstage.
Show it to Ramb in front of the door.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
舞台裏にも入れる　ビッグなVIP用のパス。
入り口の前で　ラムに見せよう。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: TripTicket
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: 旅行券

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
A ticket to nowhere. It shows a map
pointing to the left of a red X...
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
ドコデモナイへの切符。赤い×マークの
左を指し示す地図が描いてある…

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: LancerCon
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: ランサーコン

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: Lancer's controller. It's covered in dirt.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: ランサーのコントローラー。土まみれ。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: LancerConX~1
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: ランサーコン X ~1

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: Lancer's controllers. They're covered in dirt.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: ランサーのコントローラー。土まみれ。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: SheetMusic
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: 楽譜

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Music that Susie attempted to transcribe.
USE it to read it.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
スージィが　音符を書き写そうとしたもの。
「つかう」と読める。

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en: ClaimbClaws
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja: ノボるのツメ

scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.en:
Claws so small they conveniently can't
be seen. Use them to climb up obvious walls.
scr_keyiteminfo_slash_scr_keyiteminfo_gm.ja:
とても小さくて　都合よく目に見えないツメ。
使えば　いかにも登れそうなカベを登れる。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_1_.ja: ＊ しかいが　ぼやけた。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_5_.ja: ＊ しんぞうが　たかなった。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_8_.en: * "Hot Chocolate" - Topped with home-made marshmallows in the shape of bunnies.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_8_.ja:
＊ ホットチョコレート - ウサギの
　 かたちの　てづくりマシュマロが
　 うかんでいる。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_11.en:
* "Pencil" - Weapon 1 AT
* Mightier than a sword?
* Maybe equal at best.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_11.ja:
＊ エンピツ - ぶきAT1
＊ けんより　つよし？
＊ …せいぜい　おなじぐらい　かな。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_14.en:
* "Bandage" - Heals 10 HP
* It has cartoon characters on it.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_14.ja:
＊ ばんそうこう - 10HPかいふく
＊ キャラクターの　えが
　 かいてある。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_17.en: * "Bouquet" - A bouquet of beautiful flowers in many colors.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_17.ja:
＊ はなたば - いろとりどりの　はなを
　 なんぼんも　たばねた　うつくしい
　 ブーケ。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_18.en: * Perhaps it could be offered to someone.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_18.ja:
＊ だれかに　あげると
　 よろこばれそう。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_21.en: * "Ball of Junk" - A small ball of accumulated things in your pocket.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_21.ja:
＊ 「ゴミのかたまり」 - ポケットの
　 なかの　なにかが　ギュッと
　 まるまった　ちいさな　かたまり。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_25.en: * "Ball of Junk" - A small ball of accumulated things in your pocket.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_25.ja:
＊ 「ゴミのかたまり」 - ポケットの
　 なかの　なにかが　ギュッと
　 まるまった　ちいさな　かたまり。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_26.en: * It smells like scratch'n'sniff marshmallow stickers.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_26.ja:
＊ 「こするとマシュマロの
　 かおりがするシール」のような
　 においが　する。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_30.en:
* "Halloween Pencil" - Weapon 1 AT
* Orange with black bats on it.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_30.ja:
＊ 「ハロウィンエンピツ」 - ぶき　AT1
＊ オレンジいろの　エンピツ。くろい
　 コウモリの　もようが　ついている。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_33.en:
* "Lucky Pencil" - Weapon 1 AT
* Covered in green clovers and rainbows.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_33.ja:
＊ 「ラッキーエンピツ」 - ぶき　AT1
＊ ぜんたいに　みどりのクローバーと
　 にじの　えが　かかれた　エンピツ。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_36.en: * "Egg" - Not too important, not too unimportant.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_36.ja:
＊ 「タマゴ」 - そんなに　だいじじゃ
　 ないし　それほど　だいじじゃない
　 わけでもない。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_39.en: * "Cards" - The Jack of Spades, and the Rules Card.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_39.ja:
＊ 「トランプ」 - スペードのジャックと
　 ルールのカード。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_42.en: * "Box of Heart Candy" - It's not yours. Will that stop you?
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_42.ja:
＊ 「ハートのハコいりチョコ」 -
　 じぶんのじゃない。
　 けど　それがどうした？

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_45.en: * There is a small shard of something in your pocket.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_45.ja:
＊ ポケットに
　 なにかの　ちいさな　かけらが
　 はいっている。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_46.en: * It feels like glass, but...
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_46.ja: ＊ ガラスのような　しつかんだけど…？

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_49.en:
* "Eraser" - Weapon 1 AT
* Pink, it bounces when thrown on the ground.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_49.ja:
＊ 「けしごむ」 - ぶき AT1
＊ ピンクいろ。ゆかにおちると
　 ビヨンと　はねる。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_52.en:
* "Mechanical Pencil" - 1 AT
* It's tempting to click it repeatedly.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_52.ja:
＊ 「シャープペンシル」 - ぶき AT1
＊ ついつい　なんども
　 カチカチしがち。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_55.en:
* "Wristwatch" - Armor 1 DF
* Maybe an expensive antique.
* Stuck before half past noon.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_55.ja:
＊ 「うでどけい」 - ぼうぐ DEF1
＊ アンティークかも？　12じ30ぷんの
　 まえで　とまっている

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_59.en:
* "Holiday Pencil" - 1 AT
* A festive candycane pencil.
* Do not eat.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_59.ja:
＊ 「ホリデーエンピツ」  - ATK+1
＊ キャンディステッキのかたち。
＊ たべられない。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_62.en:
* "CactusNeedle" - 2 AT
* Ouch! ... It's somewhat sentimental in a way.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_62.ja:
＊ 「サボテンのトゲ」 - ATK+2
＊ イタイ…！　…こころが。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_65.en:
* "BlackShard" - A small chip of extremely hard glass.
* Oddly, it's nearly opaque.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_65.ja:
＊ 「ブラックシャード」 - ものすごく
　 かたいガラスの　ちいさなかけら。
＊ ほとんど　ふとうめい。

scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_68.en:
* "QuillPen" - 1 AT
* A pen fashioned from a white feather.
scr_litemdesc_slash_scr_litemdesc_gml_68.ja:
＊ 「はねペン」 - ATK+1
＊ えの　ぶぶんが　しろいはねで
　 できているペン。

scr_litemname_slash_scr_litemname_gml_15.ja: ハコいりハートチョコ

　 たちそうには　みえない。

* You looked at the junk ball in admiration.

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_10.ja:

　 ハコいりチョコ？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_11.en: * you wanna make a return on these, don't you?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_11.ja:

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.ja:
＊ おい！
　 どこで　みつけてきたんだよ
　 それ！

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.en: * ... someone gave it to you?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.ja: ＊ …あ？　「もらった」？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.en: * HAHAHA!! YEAH RIGHT!!! You stole it, didn't you!?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.ja:
＊ ガーッハッハッ！
　 まーたまた！
　 どーせ　ぬすんだんだろ！？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.en: * Well, c'mon!! Let's eat it and hide the evidence!!
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.ja:
＊ うし　とっとと　くって
　 しょうこは

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.en: * (You and Susie shared the heart-shaped box of candies.)
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.ja:
＊ (スージィと　いっしょに

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.en: * (Both of you had a feeling in your chest...)
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.ja:
＊ (ふたりとも　むねに

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_14.en: * (... that you shouldn't have eaten all of it.)
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_14.ja:
＊ (…それは　「いちどに　ぜんぶ
　 たべたのは　まちがいだった」という
　 こうかいの　きもちだ)

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_14.en: * (You unhesitatingly devoured the box of heart shaped candies.)
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_14.ja:
＊ (ハートのハコいりチョコを
　 ためらうことなく　むさぼった)

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_15.en: * (You accept this destruction as part of life...)
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_15.ja:
＊ (これもまた　じんせいと
　 うけいれた…)

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_20.en: * You looked through the glass.
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_20.ja:
＊ ガラスを　とおして
　 むこうを　みた。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_21.en: * For some strange reason, for just a brief moment...
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_21.ja: ＊ なぜか　ほんの　いっしゅん…

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_21.en: * You thought you saw Noelle close against you, whispering.
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_21.ja:
＊ ノエルが　すぐちかくで

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_22.ja: ＊ けしごむを　そうびした。

* Hello?
* Dreemurr residence...

＊ もしもし？
＊ ドリーマーです。
＊ どちらさまですか…？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_12.en: * Sigh... Do not make me come over there.

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.ja:
＊ (でんわが　なっている…
　 が　でることが　できない)

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.en: * (You're already on the phone, after all...)
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_13.ja:
＊ (どっちにしろ

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_15.en: * Kris, honey, what is it?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_15.ja: ＊ クリス　どうしたの？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_15.ja:
＊ え？　 …だめよ。

　 なんて　いきません。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_16.en: * Our house is not far. It is just at the top of town.
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_16.ja:
＊ うちは　そんなに　とおく
　 ないでしょう？　まちの
　 いちばん　北よ。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_16.en: * Try walking. It builds character, honey.
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_16.ja:
＊ あるいて　かえって
　 いらっしゃい。こころの
　 つよいコに　なれるわよ。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_17.ja:
＊ クリス　いま　テストの

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_17.en: * I can talk to you when you get back, alright?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_17.ja:
＊ はなしが　あるなら

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_17.ja:
＊ うちは　まちの
　 いちばん　北よ。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_17.en: * (Click...)
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_17.ja: ＊ ツー…

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_27.en: * (Ring, ring...)

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_27.ja:

　 でんわだわ。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_27.en: * Kris...? What is it, honey?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_27.ja:
＊ クリス…？
　 どうしたの？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_27.en: * What? You are "normal?"
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_27.ja:
＊ え？　あなたは
　 「フツー」？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_27.en: * What? You made a "trash orb"?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_27.ja:
＊ え？
　 「ゴミのオーブ」を
　 つくったの？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_27.ja:
＊ …それは　どういう
　 イミかしら。せつめい
　 してくれる？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_27.en: * (Kris, d-don't give the phone to me!!!)
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_27.ja:
＊ (ややややめて　クリス！
　 せんせいに　でんわ
　 わたさないで…！！)

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_28.ja:
＊ え？　あとで
　 としょかんに　いくの？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_28.en: * Well, thank you for telling me this time! Have a nice time!
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_28.ja:
＊ そう。ちゃんと　おしえて
　 くれて　ありがとう。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_29.en: * Kris, do not worry about the library.
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_29.ja:
＊ クリス　としょかんへは
　 いきたいときに
　 いっていいのよ。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_30.ja: ＊ (プルルル　プルルル…)

　 これから　がっこうの
　 かだいを　やるの…？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_30.ja:
＊ …ああ　わかったわ！
　 ママに　てつだって
　 ほしいのね！？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_30.en: * I will go find our homemade scented glue-sticks!
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_30.ja:
＊ じゃあ　てづくりの
　 かおりつきノリを
　 さがしてこなきゃ！

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_30.en: * ... Oh? You have a partner this time?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_30.ja:
＊ …え？
　 こんどの　かだいは
　 おともだちと…？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_30.en: * Kris!! That's wonderful!!
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_30.ja:
＊ まあ！　じゃあ
　 その　おともだちにも…

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_30.en: * I hope they like butterscotch-scented gluesticks!
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_30.ja:

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_31.en: * Kris, do not worry about going to the library.
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_31.ja:
＊ クリス　としょかんへは
　 いきたいときに
　 いっていいのよ。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_32.en: * If Berdly harasses you about our debt...
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_32.ja:
＊ バードリーが
　 「かりを　かえせ」って
　 しつこく　いってきたら…

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_32.en: * I will come and throw a smoke bomb so you can escape.
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_32.ja:
＊ ママが　かけつけて
　 けむりだまを　なげるから
　 そのスキに　にげなさい。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_32.en: * ... maybe not. Hee hee hee. Try your best, honey.
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_32.ja:
＊ …フフフ。なんてね。
　 じょうだんよ！
　 がんばってね。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_33.en: * Hi honey! How was your group project?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_33.ja:
＊ あら！　がっこうの
　 かだいは　もう　すんだの？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_33.en: * I can give you a ride home in a minute, I am just...
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_33.ja:
＊ もうすこししたら

　 だから　ちょっとだけ…

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_34.en: * ... oh? No need?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_34.ja:
＊ …え？
　 おむかえは　いらない…？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_34.en: * You are still spending time with a friend...?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_34.ja:
＊ まだ　おともだちと
　 いっしょ…？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_34.en: * Oh dear! Two days in a row, Kris! Is that a record?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_34.ja:
＊ まあ！　２日つづけて！？
　 しんきろくじゃない？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_34.en: * Have fun, honey! Be back before sunset!
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_34.ja:
＊ じゃあ　ゆっくりあそんで
　 らっしゃい！　くらくなる
　 までには　かえるのよ？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_34.en: * (Click...)
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_34.ja: ＊ ツー…

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_34.en: * (Ring, ring...)
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_34.ja: ＊ (プルルル　プルルル…)

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_35.en: * Calling me again? What must your friend think?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_35.ja:
＊ また　ママに　でんわ？
　 おともだちは
　 どうしたの？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_35.en: * Have fun with your friend, honey!
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_35.ja:
＊ おともだちと
　 なかよく　あそぶのよ！

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_36.ja: ＊ もしもし　ドリーマーです。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_36.en: * What? You would like to talk to "Susie"?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_36.ja:
＊ え？　「スージィ」に
　 かわってほしい？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_37.en: * Of course, here you are.
* KRIS FINISH WASHING YOUR DAMN HANDS!!!
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_37.ja:
＊ クリス！！　いつまで
　 てェあらってんだよ！！

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_38.en: * Kris, the phone is going.
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_38.ja:
＊ クリス　でんわが
　 なってるわ。

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_38.en: * Would you mind getting it for me while I...
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_38.ja:
＊ いま　てが　はなせないから
　 かわりに　でてくれな…

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_38.en: * Kris? Why are you calling our house?
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_38.ja:
＊ クリス？
　 どうして　うちに
　 でんわ　しているの？

scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_39.en: * (Everybody seems too busy to pick up the phone...)
scr_litemuseb_slash_scr_litemuseb_gml_39.ja:
＊ (みんな　てが　はなせなくて
　 でんわに　でられないようだ…)

scr_lrecoitem_slash_scr_lrecoitem_gml_16.en: * Your HP was maxed out.
scr_lrecoitem_slash_scr_lrecoitem_gml_16.ja: ＊ HPが　まんたんに　なった。

THE LEGEND OF THIS WORLD.
<DELTARUNE.>

<DELTARUNE>

A WORLD BASKED IN PUREST LIGHT.

清らかな光の満ちる世界

IF FOUNTAINS FREED, THE ROARING CRIES.

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE THIRD HERO.
THE PRINCE, ALONE IN DEEPEST DARK
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
３人めの勇者
暗き闇の淵に在る 孤独な王子

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: THE CAGE, WITH HUMAN SOUL AND PARTS!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 人間の魂と部位を収めた籠

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE FIRST HERO.
THE CAGE, WITH HUMAN SOUL AND PARTS!
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
１人めの勇者
人間の魂と部位を収めた籠

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: THEY'LL HEAR THE RING OF HEAVEN'S CALL.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
彼らは聞く
天の呼ぶ音を

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: THEY'LL SEE THE TAIL OF HELL TAKE CRAWL.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
彼らは見る
這い回る地獄の尾を

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE KNIGHT WHICH MAKES
WITH BLACKENED KNIFE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 黒き刃にて生み出す騎士は

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
SHALL DUEL WITH HEROES
STRIFE BY STRIFE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 勇者たちと 決闘せん

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE QUEEN'S CHARIOT
CANNOT BE STOPPED.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: クイーンの車は 停車せず

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE LORD OF SCREENS
CLEAVED RED BY BLADE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 画面公は 紅き刃に切り裂かれん

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE FLOWER MAN, 
TRAPPED IN ASYLUM.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 花男は 施設に囚われん

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: JOCKINGTON GROWS THE BEARD.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: ジョッキントンは 髭を生やさん

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE POINTY-HEADED WILL SAY
"TOOTHPASTE," AND THEN  "BOY."
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
とんがり頭は 「キレイキレイ」
「ボーイ」と 口にせん

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: A CONUNDRUM'S FIRST FOUR TONES.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 判じ物の 最初の４音

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: A CONUNDRUM'S LAST FOUR TONES.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 判じ物の 最後の４音

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: A CONUNDRUM'S MULTITUDE TONES.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 判じ物の 多数の音

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
THE ANGEL, BANISHED, WILL
FINALLY MEET WITH ITS DESIRE.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
追放されし天使は
ついにその 希望に まみえん

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
AND THEN. WHEN ALL HOPE
IS LOST FOR THE TALE
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
やがて 伝説の希望の
すべて失われしとき

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: THE FINAL TRAGEDY UNVEILS.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 最後の悲劇 明かされん

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
FOR TO SAVE THE WORLDS,
WE LAST OF ALL SAY,
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 世界を救わんとするならば

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
ONLY THEN,
WILL THE WORLDS BE SAVED.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
そが なされれば
世界は 救われん

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
AXE CARVED BY THE
TORTOISE'S GRAND HAMMER.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
亀の大いなる槌より
生まれいでし斧

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
AND LAST, WAS THE GIRL.
AT LAST, WAS THE GIRL.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
最後に 娘が
ついに その娘が

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en:
COLDWATER FELL FROM THE
TOP OF THE SKY.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 冷たき水が 空より降り注がん

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.en: ROOTS
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: ROOTS

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: GALLERY

scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja: 娘は愛の 真の意味を知る

THE LAST PROPHECY.
THE STORY'S END.
scr_prophecytext_slash_scr_prophecytext_.ja:
最後の予言
物語の終わり

TO SAVE THE WORLDS,
THERE IS ONLY ONE WAY.

世界を救うすべは
ただ１つ

scr_recruit_info_all_slash_scr_recruit_i.ja: まだ　なかまに　なっていない。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Said to be someone's best friend, but maybe not. Shine on, you lazy diamond!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
だれかのベストフレンドだというウワサも
あるが真相は不明。クレイジーだという
評判も。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Hey, boss! I'll have a Dark Candy Starfait!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ボス！
　 わたし　ダークキャンディ・
　 サンデーサンデーにするね！

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A heart with a big heart. Always supporting others with her bullets.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ビッグなハートのハートさん。
バトルではもっぱらサポート担当。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Hathy is going to order a heart-foam latte.)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (ハーティは
　 ハートチーノ・ラテを
　 注文するようだ)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A simple organism that takes life one square at a time.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: １マス１マス日々を生きる　単細胞生物。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Looks like it wants to osmose some flavorful cubes.)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (フレーバー付きキューブを
　 吸収したいようだ)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A real dust bunny. Known to play dirty, but loves to play clean.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ホコリみたいにホワホワなウサギ。
“汚い手”を使うと評判だが
ホントは清く正しいことが好き。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Looks like it wants to be dabbed with rubbing alcohol.)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (消毒用のアルコールで
　 やさしくふいてほしいようだ)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A shape changing fighter. Ironically, blocking is not its forte.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
姿形が変わるファイター。
名前のわりに　こうげきを
ブロックするのはニガテ。
トレーニングシューズ

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Everything tastes better with a normally-shaped body!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ 体が　ちゃんとした形に整ってると
　 なにを　飲み食いしても
　 ウマいな！

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: It cries tears of joy that you are its boss.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
泣いている。
ボスになってもらって　よっぽどうれしい
ようだ。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: An agent of CHAOS, he became DEVILSKNIFE to the pocket.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
カオスをなすもの。
ポケットのデビルズナイフ。
カオスだよ:カオスだね

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Obsessed with ranger shows, it lets everyone know it's better than Rudinn.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
戦隊モノ番組マニア。モンディより
優秀だというアピールに余念がない。
録画した番組を消されること

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Boss...? You're treating me...? Oh, you shouldn't have! (smile)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ えっ…　隊長… おごってくれるで
　 ありますか…？
　 いやぁ悪いであります…(ニヤニヤ)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Although stronger than Hathy, seems to have fewer friends.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ハーティよりも強いけど
ハーティよりも　友だちいなそう。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Head Hathy drinks an ice tea in silence...)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (ヘッドハーティは　だまって
　 アイスティーを飲んでいる…)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: An aggressive antivirus. It's not down with the sickness.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
攻撃的な抗ウィルス体。
病気には絶対負けない。
ふざけたサウンドエフェクト

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Pipooo! Nothing beats a nice shot of espresso... Want me to give you a "shot", too!?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ピーポー！
　 毎食後　忘れず飲まなきゃね…
　 １杯のエスプレッソ！

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Known to say ASOBOH, which means "Let's Play!" ... does it know that?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
「…アｿボウE」が口グセ。
たぶん「遊ぼうよ」と言っている。
意味がわかっているのかは不明。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en:
* NOMU NOMU.
* BERRY GOOD!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ モグモグ…
＊ おやつ　ウマ！

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (It's drinking K_K's electric milk JPEG.)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (K_Kの　デジタルミルク.JPGを
　 飲んでいる)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: It was controlled by Queen. But, it's stronger and cooler now, so?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
クイーンに操られていたけれど
いまは強く　クールに成長。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (It has some kind of energy drink.)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (エナジードリンク的なものを
　 飲んでいる)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: It dreams of re-enacting scenes from cat and mouse cartoons.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
某ネコとネズミのアニメを再現することを
夢見ている。
ポップアップをクリックすること
＊ (溶けたチーズを　飲んでいる)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A virus with a slightly criminal streak... and a heart of gold.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ついつい犯罪に走りがち…
だけど根はいいヤツ。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Wanna share my soda? We'll both get sick that way... Hee hee.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ボクのドリンク　ひと口飲む？
　 キミも　病気になっちゃうけどね。
　 ヒヒヒ。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Colorful and dandy, you can always count on him to work hard.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
カラフルでダンディ。
どんなときでも仕事はキッチリ。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Boss? Shall we sit down and enjoy a nice earl grey?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ご主人さま。こちらのお席で
　 ごいっしょに　おいしい
　 アールグレイでも　いかがでしょう？

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: It absorbed the wire with fighting spirit. Gets flustered easily.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
闘志を燃やして　制御ケーブルを体内に
取り込んでしまった個体。
ちょっとのことですぐキョドる。
スーパーチャージ戦法

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (... it's crushing its energy drink with its hand...)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (…エナジードリンクの缶を
　 手で　にぎりつぶしている…)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Loves to coordinate outfits. Strongly dislikes clowns.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
服のコーディネートが大好き。
ピエロは大きらい。
ニューウェーブ・シンセポップ
そろっていないソックス

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: You recruited 3 big mice and you're stuck with it.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
大きなネズミ３匹。
なかまにしてしまった以上　もう逃れる
すべはない。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (It's getting electricity from the melted cheese like a water wheel)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (溶けたチーズを利用して
　 水力発電の要領で　電力を得ている)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Passionate about music, but often taken advantage of by sinister types.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
音楽に情熱を燃やすが
悪意を持つ者に利用されやすい。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Seems to just be enjoying the musical ambience.)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (ミュージックムードを
　 楽しんでいるようだ)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: Don't scream...! It's not the real monster, just the Darkner. Ooo la la.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
手なの？　目なの？　両方なの？
やだぁ～ミステリアス～！

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Shush! Don't do the move... I am photographing the drink!
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ シッ！　話しかけないで…
　 ドリンクの写真　撮ってるんだから！

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A bouncer that favors brute force over beauty. Gets lost easily.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
見た目の美しさよりも　腕力重視な用心棒。
迷子になりがち。
ボタンを押されること

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Say da word, boss... I'll give dis drink a sip it won't forget.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ボス　このドリンク　やっちまって
　 いいですか？　ズルッズルに
　 吸いつくしてやりますよ。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A real dust... frog. Known to play dirty, but loves to play... dirty.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ホコリみたいな…カエル。
“汚い手”を使うと評判だが
ホントは…汚いことが好き。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Looks like it want to be dabbed with rubbing alcohol.)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (消毒用のアルコールで
　 やさしくふいてほしいようだ)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: The chatty office star. Obviously quite a looker despite her prudish wear.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
おしゃべり好きの　オフィスの人気者。
おカタい服装をしているけれど
だれもが認める美人。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en:
* (Seems like they're drinking water.)
* (... feels questionable.)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (水を飲んでいるようだ)
＊ (…それって　どうなのか)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A sly customer that takes risk until luck strikes. ... cheating also works.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ツキがめぐってくるまで　リスクを冒す。
イカサマぐせのある　要注意人物。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * This drink's not mine? It's fine. I'm just keeping it warm.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ このドリンク　ワイのとちゃうって？
　 心配せんでええ。
　 あっためとるだけやさかい。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: The weather girl who really "makes it rain." Like... with water, though.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
いわゆる「レインメーカー」の
お天気おねえさん。
ただし　降らせるのは　ふつうに雨。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Oh no, where's Lanino? He better not be having a team relationship...
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ …ラニーノは　どこ！？
　 またチーム交際してたら　どうしよう…

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A charming weatherman who can control the weather. Which, seems like cheating.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
天気をコントロールできる
お天気おにいさん。
でも　それってズルでは…？

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Haven't been on a date alone for a while! ... which, isn't a date.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ひとりでデートなんて　ひさしぶりだ…
　 …ひとりだから
　 デートじゃないけど。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A waxy spirit that generates ghastly flames. Though, not a "real" ghost per se, it has an aversion to whips, water, and the like.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ロウのようになめらかな肌をした霊。
不気味な炎を生み出す。“本物の”
ゆうれいではなく　ムチや　水などを
極端に嫌う。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (Guei is sipping the melted wax from the ambient candles.)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (周囲のキャンドルから
　 とけたロウを　すすっている)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: An ancient aromancer, it generates magic incense and stores it in its steel shell. Easygoing, it gets along well with Guei.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
いにしえのアロマンサー。まほうのお香を
生成し　鋼の殻の中にしまう。
のんびりした性格で　グウェイと仲がよい。
勢いよく回されること

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * R e l a x...
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja: ＊ リ　ラ　ッ　ク　ス　…

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (It's drinking nothing but straight tea powder.)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (紅茶パウダーを
　 ストレートで飲んでいる)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: An old sage who can't help but mumble. It is rumored that 1000 spells are kept within his beard.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
ついブツブツひとり言を言ってしまう
年老いた賢者。そのヒゲには　千の呪文が
秘められているという。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Mumble... oh, the ancheint texts...
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ブツブツ…
　 ああ…古文書だ…

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: The aqua fairy which slumbers in the "Water Cooler". Arbitrarily does fairy-like or princess-like things (as she pleases).
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
「ウォータークーラー」の中で眠る
水の精。気が向くと　妖精っぽいことや
姫っぽいことをする。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Oh, is this tapwater? Ho hum...
A witch who engages in musical rituals. Each song she plays is a magical charm that can change one's mood... though, isn't that all music?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
音楽の儀式をとりおこなう　まじょ。
曲を演奏すれば　聴く者の気分が変わる…
が　音楽とは　もともとそういうもの。

＊ ディン…ドン…！
　 トラベル しらベル…

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (She's musically striking the side of the cup with a spoon.)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (お茶を　飲みながら
　 ホテルの予約サイトを見ている)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: The witch's familiar, a living sword. Its greatest delight is being asked to carve graffiti.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
まじょの使い魔。生きた剣。
らくがきを彫ってと頼むと
とてもよろこぶ。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * (It's carved your initials in the table...)
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ (テーブルに　イニシャルを
　 彫ってくれた…)

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A philosopher who studies the ancient words. Their light-blocking mask is said to let them commune deeper with the truth of the dark.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
いにしえの言葉を研究する哲学者。
光を遮断する仮面をかぶることで
闇の真実と深く通じることができると
される。
それがなんなのか知ること
＊ 嗚呼　お茶よ　お茶！

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Am I 1% tea, or has it become 99% me?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ ワレは１％　お茶だろうか？
　 それとも　お茶が
　 99％　ワレだろうか？

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: A regular "Mizzle" who, after ages of worship, falsely believes herself to be of great royalty. Isn't even "HOLY" elemental.
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
何世紀にもわたり崇拝されたおかげで
自分は偉大な王族だとかんちがいしている
ただのミズル。「聖」属性の精霊ですら
ない。

scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.en: * Oh, young hero. I beseeth thee; where is the VIP Chamber?
scr_recruit_info_slash_scr_recruit_info_.ja:
＊ 嗚呼　若き勇者よ。
　 ワタシに　ふさわしい
　 VIP房は　どこに？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_12_0.en: * You really didn't want to throw it away.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_12_0.ja: ＊ どうしても　すてたくない。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_19_0.en:
* You took it from your pocket.
* You have a very, very, bad feeling about throwing it away.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_19_0.ja: ＊ ポケットから　とりだした。 ＊ これを　すてる…？　なんだか 　 ものすごく　イヤな　よかんが　する。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_20_0.en: * Hand shaking, you dropped the ball of junk on the ground.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_20_0.ja:
＊ ふるえる　てで　ゴミのかたまりを
　 じめんに　すてた。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_21_0.ja: ＊ かたまりは　こなごなになった。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_22_0.ja: ＊ むねが　くるしくなった。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_34_0.en: * You felt a feeling of relief.

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_39_0.en:
* Hey, Kris! What's up?
* Didja lose your pencil again?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_39_0.ja:
＊ おはよう　クリス！
＊ どうしたの？　また
　 エンピツ　なくしちゃった？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_40_0.en: * Here, you want the candy-cane one or the one with lights on it?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_40_0.ja:
＊ いいよ　かしてあげる。
　 キャンディステッキのやつ？
　 それとも　ひかるやつ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_41_0.en:
* Huh?
* You want to be partners?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_41_0.ja:
＊ え？
＊ わたしと
　 ペアになりたいの？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_42_0.en:
* Ummm... Sorry...
* Berdly already asked me...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_42_0.ja:
＊ そっか…　ごめんね…
＊ さきに　バードリーくんに
　 たのまれちゃって…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_43_0.en: * But I could ask Ms. Alphys if we could make a group of 3!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_43_0.ja:
＊ アルフィーせんせいに
　 ３人グループでもいいか
　 きいてみようか？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_44_0.en:
* I'll ask if you're sure!
Not yet Yes. Ask.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_44_0.ja:
＊ どうする？　きいてみる？
 
   まって        きいてみて

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_51_0.ja: ＊ じゃあ　きいてみるね！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_52_0.en:
* Miss Alphys!
* Umm, is it OK if we have a group of 3?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_52_0.ja:
＊ アルフィーせんせい！
＊ えっと…　わたしたち　３人
　 グループでも　いいですか？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_57_0.en: * Yeah, I'm sure there's someone else you can ask!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_57_0.ja:
＊ そうだね
　 ほかの　みんなにも
　 たのんでみると　いいよ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_62_0.en:
* Do you wanna be partners?
Not yet Yes
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_62_0.ja:
＊ わたしたちの　グループに
　 はいりたい？
   まって        うん

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_69_0.ja: ＊ じゃあ　きいてみるね！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_70_0.en:
* Miss Alphys!
* Umm, is it OK if we have a group of 3?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_70_0.ja:
＊ アルフィーせんせい！
＊ えっと…　わたしたち　３人
　 グループでも　いいですか？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_75_0.en:
* Umm, OK.
* You just keep doing your thing, Kris.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_75_0.ja:
＊ そっか… わかった。
＊ むりに　とは　いわないよ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_80_0.en:
* Alright.
* Let's get this over with.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_80_0.ja:
＊ いくぞ。
＊ さっさと　すませようぜ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_81_0.en:
* We'll get more chalk.
* Mosey back to class.
* And then, Kris...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_81_0.ja:
＊ チョーク　とりにいって…
　 きょうしつ　もどって…
＊ そんで…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_82_0.ja:
＊ かだいは
　 おまえが　ひとりでやる。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_83_0.en:
* How's that sound?
Good Bad
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_83_0.ja:
＊ いいな？
 
   はい          いやです

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_98_0.ja: ＊ (中で　なにかが光っている)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_112_0.ja:
＊ (「グロウシャード」を
　 手に入れた)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_119_0.ja: ＊ (それは　そこに　とどまった)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_129_0.en:
* Welcome.
* I am the Prince of this Kingdom...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_129_0.ja: ＊ よくぞ参った。 ＊ われは　この王国の王子…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_130_0.ja: ＊ そして　ここは 　 闇の王国である。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_131_0.en:
* Kris, Susie...
* There is a LEGEND in this land.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_131_0.ja: ＊ クリス　スージィ… ＊ これより　わが国に残る 　 言い伝えの話をしよう。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_132_0.en: * A LEGEND that one day, two HEROES of LIGHT will arrive,
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_132_0.ja: ＊ 「いつの日か 　 ２人の　光の勇者が 　 現れるとき…」

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_133_0.en: * And fulfill the ancient prophecy, foretold by time and space.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_133_0.ja:
＊ 「…時空が語りつぐ
　 古き予言が　成るだろう」

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_134_0.en:
* Please, Heroes...
* Listen to my tale...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_134_0.ja:
＊ 勇者たちよ…
＊ われの話を
　 聞いてくれるか…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_151_0.en:
* Umm, r-really?
* Are you sure?
* It's fairly important.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_151_0.ja:
＊ え…ええぇぇ？
＊ いいんですか…？　わりと
　 大事な話なんですけど…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_152_0.en: * And... um, in my opinion, it's a really nice PROPHECY!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_152_0.ja: ＊ それに…個人的には 　 けっこう　いい感じな 　 予言だと思いますよ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_153_0.en: * I think you'd quite like it!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_153_0.ja:
＊ きっと気に入ってもらえると
　 思います！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_163_0.en:
* Phew!
* Um, very well then...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_163_0.ja:
＊ ふぅ！　よかった…
＊ で…では
　 聞かせるとしよう…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_169_0.en:
* ... really?
* You've heard it already?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_169_0.ja:
＊ …え？
＊ 聞いたこと
　 あるんですか…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_170_0.en: * Oh... Perhaps I shouldn't have rehearsed it so much...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_170_0.ja:
＊ なんだ…　じゃあ
　 がんばって　練習しなくても
　 よかったな…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_172_0.en: * Look, dude, we didn't come here for a bedtime story.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_172_0.ja:
＊ あのさ　うちら
　 つまんねー長話とか
　 興味ねーから。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_173_0.en: * Just tell us how to get home.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_173_0.ja:
＊ どうやったら帰れるかだけ
　 教えろよ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_175_0.en: * Ummm, the easiest way would be to seal the Eastern FOUNTAIN.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_175_0.ja: ＊ えっと…　いちばん 　 簡単なのは　東の泉を 　 封じることだけど…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_178_0.en: * You mean, uh, like the water bubbler or something?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_178_0.ja:
＊ なんだそれ。
　 女子の名前か？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_180_0.en:
* THE fountain.
* That which gives the DARK WORLD form.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_180_0.ja: ＊ 闇の泉です。 ＊ この　闇の世界を形づくる…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_181_0.en: * ... umm, are you sure you actually know the legend?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_181_0.ja:
＊ …ていうか…
　 言い伝え　ホントに
　 知ってます…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_185_0.ja: ＊ いや　知らねーけど。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_186_0.en: * But I think I've got enough info.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_186_0.ja:
＊ でも　聞きたいことは
　 聞けたから
　 どーでもいいな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_189_0.en:
* W-wait!
* Let me at least tell you how to...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_189_0.ja:
＊ ま…待って！
＊ 泉を封じるには…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_200_0.en: * This is the CASTLE TOWN, where my subjects reside...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_200_0.ja: ＊ This is the CASTLE TOWN, where my subjects reside...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_201_0.en: * Err, well, they would if I had any...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_201_0.ja: ＊ Err, well, they would if I had any...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_202_0_b.en: * Oh, don't worry about me, Kris!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_202_0_b.ja: ＊ Oh, don't worry about me, Kris!

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_203_0.en: * I'm certain I'll find a subject someday...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_203_0.ja: ＊ I'm certain I'll find a subject someday...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_214_0.en: * Why, Kris, you don't have to do that...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_214_0.ja: ＊ Why, Kris, you don't have to do that...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_216_0.en: * Kris, as your Prince and authority, I order you to...!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_216_0.ja: ＊ Kris, as your Prince and authority, I order you to...!

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_217_0.en: * Please let me know what to do!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_217_0.ja: ＊ Please let me know what to do!

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_224_0.en:
* Oh, thank you, Kris!
* I will!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_224_0.ja:
＊ Oh, thank you, Kris!
＊ I will!

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_232_0.en: * Er, Kris, you know you can hold [~1] to run...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_232_0.ja: ＊ ねえ　クリス… 　 [~1]を長押しすると 　 走れることは　知ってる？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_242_0.en:
* Really?
* And yet you choose not to...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_242_0.ja:
＊ えっ…？
　 じゃあ　知ってて
　 走らなかったの…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_243_0.en: * Right, who knows how long these leisurely days will last...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_243_0.ja:
＊ …そうだね。いつまで
　 こんなふうに　のんびり旅が
　 できるか　わからないしね。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_244_0.en: * There's nothing wrong with taking your time, Kris.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_244_0.ja:
＊ いいよ！　自分のペースで
　 進んでいこう。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_250_0.en:
* Right!
* You'll move faster by holding [~1]!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_250_0.ja: ＊ そうなの！ ＊ [~1]を長押しすると 　 速く移動できるんだよ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_251_0.en: * And I'll be right behind you, so don't worry!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_251_0.ja:
＊ ボクも　ちゃんと
　 うしろに　ついてくから
　 安心してね！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_252_0.en: * ... Unless you want to get away, in which case, sorry.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_252_0.ja:
＊ …ついてきてほしくない
　 なんてことは…
　 ないよね…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_262_0.en: * Umm, Kris, did you know...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_265_0.en: * ... You can skip text by pressing [~1]?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_265_0.ja: ＊ ... You can skip text by pressing [~1]?

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_273_0.en:
* ... Really?
* So you've just been...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_274_0.en: * Listening to me talk, because you wanted to?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_274_0.ja:
＊ キミはずっと　ボクの話を…
　 聞きたいから
　 聞いてくれてたってこと？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_275_0.en: * I'll try to make it worth your while, Kris!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_275_0.ja:
＊ ボク…キミの気持ちに
　 応えられるように
　 がんばるよ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_280_0.en: * Right! In the case you read very quickly.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_280_0.ja:
＊ そうなの！　ひょっとしたら
　 キミは　速読マスターかも
　 しれないしね。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_281_0.en: * Or you're tired of what's being said.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_281_0.ja:
＊ …いちいち聞くのが
　 めんどくさいときにも
　 使えるけど…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_282_0.en: * ... No need to skip my text, right, Kris?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_282_0.ja:
＊ でもクリスは…ボクとの
　 会話をスキップしたいなんて
　 思わないよね…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_293_0.en:
* Oh, Kris!
* It's the training dummy I made!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_293_0.ja:
＊ クリス！　見て！
＊ ボクが作った　訓練用の
　 マネキンがあるよ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_294_0.en: * Now seems like a great chance to prepare for the enemy.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_294_0.ja:
＊ ちょうどいい機会だから
　 敵とのバトルに
　 備えておかない？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_295_0.en: * Would you like me to teach you how to fight?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_295_0.ja:
＊ よかったら　戦い方を
　 教えてあげるよ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_303_0.en:
* OK!
* Get ready, Kris!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_303_0.ja:
＊ うん　わかった！
＊ それじゃ　始めよう！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_308_0.en: * Right, you already fought Lancer, didn't you...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_308_0.ja:
＊ そっか　さっきもう
　 ランサーさんと
　 戦ったもんね…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_309_0.en: * I was so excited to teach you, I absolutely blanked!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_309_0.ja:
＊ 教えてあげるのが
　 楽しみすぎて
　 うっかりしてたな…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_310_0.en:
* ... B-but, um...
* Just in case you forgot anything...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_310_0.ja:
＊ じゃあ…
＊ 戦い方を　忘れちゃった
　 ときのために…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_311_0.en:
* Here!
* I made a Manual for you and Susie!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_311_0.ja:
＊ はい　これ！
＊ キミと　スージィのために
　 マニュアルを作ったんだ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_314_0_b.en: * Press [~1] to open the menu and use it in your ITEMS.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_314_0_b.ja: ＊ Press [~1] to open the menu and use it in your ITEMS.

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_314_0.ja: ＊ (マニュアルを　手に入れた)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_323_0.en:
* Oh my!
* The Great Door is opened?!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_323_0.ja:
＊ え…っ！
＊ 「大とびら」が…
　 開いてる！？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_324_0.en: * No wonder Lancer was able to come through...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_324_0.ja:
＊ そっか…　ランサーさんが
　 こっち側へ来られたのは
　 そういうわけだったんだ…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_326_0.en: * Kris, once we pass through this door...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_326_0.ja:
＊ クリス…
　 このとびらを抜けたら…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_327_0.en: * Our adventure will really begin.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_327_0.ja:
＊ ボクたちの旅は
　 本当に始まってしまう。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_328_0.en: * A journey foretold exactly by the prophecy...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_328_0.ja:
＊ 予言に伝えられる
　 勇者の旅がね…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.en: * But, Kris, I believe YOUR choices are important, too.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_329_0.ja:
＊ だけど…ボクは　キミが
　 自分の意志で決めることも
　 とても大事だと思うんだ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.en: * This world is full of all kinds of people, Kris.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_330_0.ja:
＊ この世界には　本当に
　 いろんなひとたちがいる。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.en: * In the end, how we treat them makes all the difference.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_331_0.ja:
＊ 大切なのは　そのひとたちと
　 どう接するか　だと思う。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.en: * So let's try our best to get by without FIGHTing.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_332_0.ja:
＊ だから　なるべく
　 誰とも　たたかわなくて
　 すむようにしよう。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_333_0.en: * If we can manage to do that...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.en: * I believe this tale may have a happy ending.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_334_0.ja:
＊ この物語は
　 ハッピーエンドを
　 むかえられると思うんだ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_335_0.ja:
＊ でも　そうしなかった
　 場合は…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_336_0.en: * ... you may not... find the result favorable.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_336_0.ja:
＊ キミにとって残念な結末に
　 なってしまうかもしれない…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_337_0.en: * ... Oh, I'm sorry! Is that too much to ask?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_337_0.ja:
＊ あ…ゴメン！
　 ちょっと難しい
　 お願いだったかな…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.en: * Kris, I knew you were a hero the moment I saw you.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_343_0.ja:
＊ やっぱり　キミは勇者だ！
　 一目見た瞬間
　 そう思ったよ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_344_0.en: * Let's try our best, alright?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_344_0.ja: ＊ それじゃ　がんばろうね。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0.en: * Kris, in the end, what you choose is up to you.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_349_0.ja:
＊ やっぱり　気にしないで。
　 どうするかは
　 キミの自由だから。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.en: * As long as you're happy with it, I'm happy too.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_350_0.ja:
＊ キミが満足なら
　 ボクも　それで満足だよ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_351_0.en: * So just try your best, and don't worry!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_351_0.ja:
＊ だから…
　 できる範囲で
　 がんばろう！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_364_0.en: * (There are two objects hanging from the tree.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_364_0.ja:
＊ (木の枝に　なにかが２つ
　 ぶらさがっている)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_370_0.en: * (There's a candy hanging from the tree.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_370_0.ja:
＊ (木の枝に　キャンディが１つ
　 ぶらさがっている)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_377_0.en: * (There's nothing hanging low enough to take.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_377_0.ja:
＊ (手の届く高さに
　 ぶらさがっているものはない)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_388_0.ja: ＊ (ダークキャンディを　手に入れた)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_393_0.ja: ＊ (持ちものが　いっぱいだ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_399_0.en: * (You decided to let the tree keep it.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_399_0.ja:
＊ (そのまま　木に持たせておく
　 ことにした)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_410_0.en: * (There are two objects hanging from the tree.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_410_0.ja:
＊ (木の枝に　なにかが２つ
　 ぶらさがっている)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_416_0.en: * (There's a candy hanging from the tree.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_416_0.ja:
＊ (木の枝に　キャンディが１つ
　 ぶらさがっている)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_423_0.en: * (There's nothing hanging low enough to take.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_423_0.ja:
＊ (手の届く高さに
　 ぶらさがっているものはない)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_434_0.ja: ＊ (ダークキャンディを　手に入れた)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_439_0.ja: ＊ (持ちものが　いっぱいだ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_445_0.en: * (You decided to let the tree keep it.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_445_0.ja:
＊ (そのまま　木に持たせておく
　 ことにした)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_456_0.en: * (The remains of the cake are still smoldering...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_456_0.ja:
＊ (ケーキの残がいからは
　 まだ　煙が立ちのぼっている…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_462_0.en: * (The remains of the cake are still smoldering...)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_462_0.ja:
＊ (ケーキの残がいからは
　 まだ　煙が立ちのぼっている…)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_473_0.en: * (The Broken Cake was added to your KEY ITEMS.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_473_0.ja: ＊ (「こわれたケーキ」が 　 だいじなものに加わった)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_478_0.ja: ＊ (持ちものが　いっぱいだ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_484_0.en: * (You decided putting cake in your pockets is a bad idea.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_484_0.ja:
＊ (ケーキは　ポケットに
　 入れないほうが　よさそうだ)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_492_0.ja:
クシャ
クシャ
の紙

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_493_0.ja:
ランサーと
書いて
ある紙

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_496_0.en: * Alright, everyone's put in their entries!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_496_0.ja:
＊ はい！
　 みんな入れたな！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_497_0.en: * Blue person, you can choose.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_497_0.ja:
＊ んじゃあ
　 そこの　青いおまえ！
　 選べ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_498_0.en: * Since you look like you don't care.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_498_0.ja:
＊ なんかおまえ「自分
　 どーでもいいっすわー」
　 みたいな顔してるから！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_508_0.en: * (You take the crumpled up piece of paper.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_508_0.ja:
＊ (クシャクシャに丸められた
　 紙切れを　手に取った)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_511_0.en:
* OK!!
* And your name is...!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_511_0.ja:
＊ 発表します！
＊ おまえたちの
　 チーム名は…！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_513_0.en: * I don't think I'm allowed to say this one.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_513_0.ja:
＊ これは…
　 ボクさまは　言っちゃダメな
　 言葉だと思う…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_517_0.en: * Woah, I'm not allowed to say Tier-TWO swear words!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_517_0.ja:
＊ おわわ！　お下品レベル２の
　 言葉！　ボクさまは
　 言っちゃダメなヤツ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_518_0.en: * Wow. You three's collective dad must be very cool.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_518_0.ja:
＊ おまえたち３人の
　 共同パパは　怒らないの？
　 うらやましい。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_520_0.en: * Er, could we PERHAPS consider a DIFFERENT name?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_520_0.ja:
＊ あの…
　 やっぱり　別の名前に
　 しませんか？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_522_0.en: * Ralsei, you don't HAVE to be in our Squad.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_522_0.ja:
＊ ラルセイ　イヤなら
　 抜けてもらっていいんだぜ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_524_0.en: * Yeah! How about I be in the Squad and YOU be the bad guy?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_524_0.ja:
＊ そうだそうだ！　代わりに
　 ボクさまが入る！　そんで
　 おまえが悪モノやればいい。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_525_0.en:
* Here.
* Call up my dad.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_525_0.ja:
＊ ほら。
＊ パパ上に　電話しろ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_526_0.en: * Tell him he has a new son.

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_527_0.en: * One that has to take a shower every time he reads a swear word.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_527_0.ja:
＊ 「汚い言葉を言うたびに
　 シャワー浴びにいく
　 いいコちゃんです」ってな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_529_0.en:
* OK, fine!
* We can keep the name!
* I just won't say it.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_529_0.ja:
＊ わ…わかりましたよ！
＊ その名前で　いいです！
＊ でも　ボクは　言わないぞ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_531_0.ja:
＊ ハハハ　ボクさまも
　 言わないぞ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_532_0.en:
* See ya, losers!
* It's shower time!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_532_0.ja:
＊ さらばだ　敗者さんたち！
＊ 早くシャワー浴びなきゃ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_540_0.en: * (You take the paper with "LANCER" written on the outside.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_540_0.ja:
＊ (表に「ランサー」と書いてある紙を
　 手に取った)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_542_0.en:
* (On the inside...)
* (It also says "LANCER.")
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_542_0.ja:
＊ (中には…)
＊ (「ランサー」と書いてある)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_544_0.en:
* Wow, who did that one?
* It's really good!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_544_0.ja:
＊ おおお　これは　誰のだ？
＊ とっても　いい名前だ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_546_0.en: * Wait, why do YOU get to choose the name?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_546_0.ja:
＊ 待ってください。どうして
　 あなたが　ボクたちの
　 チーム名を決めるの…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_548_0.en:
* Hey.
* He didn't, Kris did.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_548_0.ja:
＊ いや。
＊ 決めたのは　クリスだぜ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_550_0.en:
* Yeah!
* It doesn't matter who MAY have written it!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_550_0.ja:
＊ そうだぞ！　仮に
　 それを　書いたのが
　 ボクさまだったとしても…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_551_0.en: * Regardless, LANCER's going to meet absolute doom!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_551_0.ja:
＊ だからなんだというのだ！ 
　 いずれにせよ　ランサーは
　 滅ぶ運命なのだ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_552_0.en: * ... this name feels weird, actually.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_552_0.ja:
＊ …う。
　 やっぱり　この名前
　 ヘンな感じだな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_554_0.en: * I know! Let's call it the LANCER FAN CLUB for short!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_554_0.ja:
＊ よし！　略して
　 「ランサー・ファンクラブ」
　 にしよう！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_555_0.ja:
＊ では　また会おう
　 ボクさま！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_563_0.en: * (You take the neatly folded piece of paper.)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_563_0.ja:
＊ (きちんと　たたまれた紙を
　 手に取った)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_566_0.en: * "The Legendary Heroes: The Herald of Fun and Friendship"
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_566_0.ja:
＊ 「伝説の勇者たち：
　 楽しい友情の予感」

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_568_0.en:
* Oh, oh!
* That's mine!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_568_0.ja:
＊ あ！　はい！
＊ それ　ボクのです！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_569_0.en: * See, I think it's the perfect name...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_569_0.ja:
＊ 個人的には　ボクたちに
　 ぴったりの名前だと
　 思うな…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_570_0.en: * Because we're all friends: That like to have a lot of fun.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_570_0.ja:
＊ だってボクたち３人は
　 友だちだし　楽しいことが
　 大好きだし…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_572_0.en: * Okay, first... jeez, that's a mouthful, dude.

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_573_0.en: * Second, what are our enemies gonna think?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_573_0.ja:
＊ それに　敵が聞いたら
　 どう思う？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_574_0.en: * That we're gonna be BUDDIES with 'em?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_574_0.ja:
＊ ヤツらとダチに
　 なりたがってると
　 かんちがいされっぞ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_575_0.en: * Let's change it to something SHORT! INTIMIDATING!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_575_0.ja:
＊ もっと短くて　敵が聞いたら
　 ふるえあがるようなのに
　 しようぜ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_576_0.ja:
＊ インパクトあって
　 すんげー強そうなヤツな！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_580_0.en:
* Well, uh...
* Y'know, for starters...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_581_0.en:
* How about...
* JUST, uh...

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_583_0.en: * Ya know, just, uh, concentrating on the "Fun" part.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_583_0.ja:
＊ ほら　アレだよ
　 「たのしい」の部分に
　 的を　しぼったんだよ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_586_0.en: * Well, see ya, Fun Gang!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_586_0.ja:
＊ んじゃ　またな
　 たのしみ隊！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_587_0.en: * I've got to osmose my afternoon milk!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_587_0.ja:
＊ ボクさまは
　 アフタヌーンミルクを
　 吸収する時間だ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_600_0.en: * Well jingle my goshdarn bells! Looks like Krismas came early!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_600_0.ja:
＊ こりゃ　ジングルべらぼうに
　 おどろいた！　ことしはもう
　 “クリス”マスかい！？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_601_0.en: * Alright, Kris. Just gimme the straight shot.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_601_0.ja:
＊ なあんて　じょうだんは
　 さておき…　きょうはまた
　 どうしたんだい？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_602_0.en:
* Why you here?
* Did your mom make you come here?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_602_0.ja:
＊ ママに　いわれて
　 きたのかい？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_612_0.en: * Hey, Kris, you wanna chat or something?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_612_0.ja:
＊ ほかにも　はなしたいことが
　 あるのかな？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_613_0.en: * Don't worry, there's no way you can bore me right now!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_613_0.ja:
＊ えんりょは　いらないぞ。
　 おじさん　いま　ヒマだけは
　 たーっぷりあるからねえ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_619_0.en:
* Hahaha, that's what I thought!
* She's a PEACH, huh...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_619_0.ja:
＊ ははは　やっぱり！
＊ あのひとは…そう　“モモ”
　 みたいな　ひとだからなあ…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_620_0.en: * Fuzzy n' sweet on the outside, a total NUT on the inside!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_620_0.ja:
＊ そとは　フワフワで
　 スイート…　でも　しんは
　 ゴツゴツの　カッチカチだ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_621_0.en: * Oh, your dad? Yeah, he's a real fruit himself too.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_621_0.ja:
＊ ん？　きみのパパかい？
　 アズゴアも　やっぱり
　 フルーツみたいなヤツだよ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_622_0.en: * Which one? I dunno, probably a hairy one... like a kiwi.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_622_0.ja:
＊ どのフルーツかって？
　 うーん　けむくじゃら
　 だから…　キウイ　かな？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_626_0.en: * Okay, okay, seriously, you wanna chat or something?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_626_0.ja:
＊ ま　じょうだんは
　 さておき　はなしたいこと
　 でも　あるのかな？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_630_0.en:
* Really?
* You've grown up a lot, Kris.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_630_0.ja:
＊ へえ？
＊ クリスも　ずいぶん
　 オトナに　なったなあ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_631_0.ja: ＊ おじさんも　うれしいよ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_632_0.en: * Wasn't too long ago you were just the creepy kid next door.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_632_0.ja:
＊ ちょっと　まえまで　なにを
　 かんがえてるのか　わからん
　 おとなりのコ　だったのに。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_633_0.en: * Now you're the creepy kid right in front of me!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_633_0.ja:
＊ いまじゃ　なにを
　 かんがえてるのか　わからん
　 めのまえのコだ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_635_0.en: * Okay, okay, seriously, you wanna chat or something?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_635_0.ja:
＊ ま　じょうだんは
　 さておき　はなしたいこと
　 でも　あるのかな？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_646_0.en: * She's a sweetheart, isn't she, Kris?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_646_0.ja:
＊ ノエルは　ほんとうに
　 いいコだ。クリスも
　 そうおもうだろう？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_647_0.en: * Smart, kind, sweet... couldn't ask for a better daughter.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_647_0.ja:
＊ かしこくて　やさしくて…
　 おじさんには　もったいない
　 ぐらいの　むすめだよ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_648_0.en: * I just wish she wasn't so... defenseless.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_648_0.ja:
＊ ただなあ…　こわがりな
　 ところだけは　おじさんも
　 きがかりでねえ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_649_0.en: * Scary movies, bugs, Santa Claus... everything scares her.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_649_0.ja:
＊ ホラーえいがに　ムシに
　 サンタクロース…　とにかく
　 なんでもこわがって…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_650_0.en: * And when it happens, she freezes like a deer in headlights.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_650_0.ja:
＊ ヘッドライトに　てらされた
　 シカみたいに
　 かたまってしまうだろう？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_651_0.en: * Remember she used to even be afraid of humans under the bed?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_651_0.ja:
＊ ちいさいころは　ベッドの
　 したに　ニンゲンがいると
　 いって　こわがってたしな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_652_0.en: * (Kris, it was NOT nice of you to hide under there, by the way!)
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_652_0.ja:
＊ (クリスも　かくれて
　 こわがらせたりするから…
　 この　イタズラっこめ！)

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_653_0.en: * ... anyhow, that's what's tough about being in here, Kris.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_653_0.ja:
＊ とにかく　にゅういん
　 してると　そればっかりが
　 なやみのタネだよ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_654_0.en: * Not what's going on with me.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_654_0.ja:
＊ じぶんの　からだのこと
　 なんかよりね。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_655_0.en: * Just that... in the meantime, I can't be there to protect her.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_655_0.ja:
＊ ノエルを　ちかくで
　 まもってやれない…
　 それが　なにより　つらい。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_656_0.en: * Keep an eye out for her, OK?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_656_0.ja:
＊ あのコのこと
　 よろしく　たのむよ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_660_0.en: * Kris, even if we've grown apart, we still love your family.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_660_0.ja:
＊ うちの一家は　みんな
　 いまでも　クリスのかぞくが
　 だいすきだ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_661_0.en: * After all, me and Asgore were college pals, right?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_661_0.ja:
＊ そういえば…
　 アズ坊も　もう
　 だいがくせいか…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_662_0.en: * Oh hey... now that Asriel's off to college...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_662_0.ja:
＊ そういえば…
　 アズ坊も　もう
　 だいがくせいか…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_663_0.en: * Y'think he's doing any CRAZY parties, like me and your dad?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_663_0.ja:
＊ おじさんと　クリスのパパが
　 だいがくせいの　ころは
　 パーティざんまいだったぞ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_664_0.en: * Heh, I'm just pulling your leg. Your dad was no party animal.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_664_0.ja:
＊ …なーんてな。アズゴアは
　 パーティモンスターなんか
　 じゃ　なかったさ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_665_0.en: * Your MOTHER on the other hand...! Whoo!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_665_0.ja:
＊ でも　クリスのママは…
　 ありゃ　すじがねいり
　 だったなあ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_666_0.en: * She'd alway fuss about going, but once the party started...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_666_0.ja:
＊ いつも　でかけるまでは
　 「いきたくない」って
　 さんざん　しぶるクセに…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_667_0.ja:
＊ パーティが　はじまった
　 とたん　はじけるんだから
　 なあ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_668_0.en: * Once she hit me clear across the room with a key lime pie!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_668_0.ja:
＊ パーティかいじょうで
　 とおくから　ライムパイを
　 なげつけられたこともある！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_669_0.en: * I got smashed into the snack table and toppled everything!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_669_0.ja:
＊ おじさん　テーブルに
　 つっこんで　りょうりが
　 ぜんぶ　だいなしになった！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_982_0.en:
* That was like...
* The best night EVER!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_982_0.ja:
＊ も～…
＊ サイッコーだった～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_983_0.en: * Even though I spilled the entire punch bowl all over him...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_983_0.ja:
＊ あたしが　アズにゃんに
　 あたまから　フルーツパンチ
　 ブッかけちゃって…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_984_0.en: * And danced inappropriately in front of your mom...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_984_0.ja:
＊ アズにゃんの　ママのまえで
　 おイロけ　ぜんかいで
　 おどっちゃったりして…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_985_0.en: * And got arrested in the parking lot for making a scene...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_985_0.ja:
＊ そんで　ちゅうしゃじょうで
　 おおさわぎして　けいさつに
　 つかまって…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_986_0.en:
* Hahaha! That was SO much fun!
* Tell him I said hi!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_986_0.ja:
＊ あはは！　も～
　 チョーゼツたのしかった～！
＊ ヨロシクいっといてね！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_990_0.en: * Like, that green girl next door?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_990_0.ja:
＊ つか　となりにすんでる
　 みどりのコのこと～？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_991_0.en:
* Oh my god, Krissy.
* She's like... my LIFE VILLAIN.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_991_0.ja:
＊ あのコって～　マジメに～
＊ あたしの　「しゅくてき」
　 だから～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_992_0.en: * Like, the other day, I went to see Cat Petters 2...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_992_0.ja:
＊ てか　このまえも
　 「キャット・ナデラー２」を
　 みにいったら～…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_993_0.en: * And the only other person in the theater was her!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_993_0.ja:
＊ えいがかんに　あたしと
　 あのコ　２人っきりで～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_994_0.en: * Then I went to QC's and ordered a Catpuccino...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_994_0.ja:
＊ そのあと「QCダイナー」で
　 キャットプチーノ
　 たのんだら～

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_995_0.en: * And she, like, was already drinking one!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_995_0.ja:
＊ あのコ　さきにきて
　 もう　キャットプチーノ
　 のんでてぇ～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_996_0.en:
* She's SUCH a copycat!
* ... uhh, copygator?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_996_0.ja:
＊ マネすんなっつの！
　 サルかよ！
＊ …あ　ワニか。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_997_0.en:
* Copysaurus?
* Copodile?
* IDK, she sucks!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_997_0.ja:
＊ てか　キョウリュウ？
＊ ハチュウルイ？
＊ とにかく　ムカツク～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1001_0.en:
* Ooo, how's Catti doing?
* I have no idea.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1001_0.ja:
＊ え～　キャッティーが
　 どうしてるかって～？
＊ しらな～い。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1002_0.en: * We, like, totally can't connect at all!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1002_0.ja:
＊ てか　あのコとは
　 ぜんっぜん
　 きが　あわないし～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1003_0.en: * Yesterday, I asked if she wanted to hear me play the ukelele...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1003_0.ja:
＊ きのうも～　キャッティーに
　 「ウクレレ　ひいてあげる」
　 っつったら～…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1004_0.en:
* She said no!
* And then she, like, told me...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1004_0.ja:
＊ 「やめて」とかいうの～！
＊ しかも～…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1005_0.en: * My playing is "an anti-blessing from Planet Hell."
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1005_0.ja:
＊ 「アネキの　えんそうは
　 ヘル星から　ふりそそぐ
　 あんこくの　のろい」って。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1006_0.ja:
＊ はぁ～～～！？
　 って　かんじ～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1007_0.en:
* That's SOOO cute!
* I love my fricked-up lil sis!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1007_0.ja:
＊ それって　チョーゼツ
　 カワイイんですけど～！
＊ キャッティー　マジラブ～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1011_0.en:
* Oh, you gotta go?
* Do you have, like, homework...?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1011_0.ja:
＊ あ　もう　いく系？
＊ しゅくだい　やんなきゃ
　 てきな？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1012_0.en: * You should, like, let me help!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1012_0.ja:
＊ じゃあ～
　 あたし　てつだう～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1013_0.en:
* Hahaha, JK!
* I totally don't want to! Laters!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1013_0.ja:
＊ な～んつってぇ～！
＊ ウソウソ　やるわけ
　 ないし！　じゃね～ん！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1022_0.en:
* Krissy!
* Like, long time no see!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1022_0.ja:
＊ クリリぃ～！
＊ てか　めっちゃ
　 ひさしぶり～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1023_0.en:
* What's up?
* Did you wanna talk about something?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1023_0.ja:
＊ なになになに？
＊ どしたの～？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1030_0.en: * Ugh, that chick next door drives me NUTS.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1030_0.ja:
＊ てか　となりに　すんでるコ
　 マジ　サイアク
　 なんですけど。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1031_0.en:
* I keep seeing her EVERYWHERE I go.
* She's a TOTAL copycat.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1031_0.ja:
＊ どこいっても　でくわすし～
　 マネしてんじゃねーよ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1032_0.en:
* Like, WHY though?
* Doesn't she realize she'll NEVER be me?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1032_0.ja:
＊ てか　なんで？
＊ マネしたら　あたしみたいに
　 なれるとか　おもってんの？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1033_0.en: * Honestly, her whole family is, like, SO trashy.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1033_0.ja:
＊ つか　ぶっちゃけ
　 あのコんち　かぞくぜんいん
　 ホント　ショボくて～

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1034_0.en: * Once her sister served me a coffee and I swear it was half cat fur.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1034_0.ja:
＊ あのコの　いもうとが
　 だしたコーヒー　ネコのけが
　 ドッサリ　はいってて～

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1035_0.en: * Like, get a hairnet, girl. For, like, your whole body.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1035_0.ja:
＊ てか　ヘアネットかぶれよ？
　 からだじゅう　ヘアネット
　 かぶれよ？　みたいな？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1040_0.en: * Remember that time you wanted to hang out with us big kids?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1040_0.ja:
＊ クリリぃ　むかし　うちら
　 おねーさんたちと
　 あそびたがったでしょ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1041_0.en: * I was like, "yeah, of course! Just get us some burgers!"
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1041_0.ja:
＊ あのとき～　「ハンバーガー
　 もってきたら　あそん
　 だげる」っていったら～

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1042_0.en:
* Then, like, amazingly...
* You ACTUALLY got them...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1042_0.ja:
＊ クリリぃ　ほんとに
　 もってきて～…
　 うっそ！　ってかんじで～

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1043_0.en: * So I told you to go back and get some french fries, too...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1043_0.ja:
＊ んで　ついでだから
　 ポテトと…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1044_0.en: * ... then a dozen miniature cakes...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1044_0.ja:
＊ …ミニケーキも　い～っぱい
　 もってこさせたんだよね～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1045_0.en: * They were SO good, I ate like six!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1045_0.ja:
＊ そのケーキが
　 めちゃウマで～　あたし
　 ６コも　たべちゃってぇ～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1046_0.en:
* Then I like...
* Suddenly got so sick I had to go home.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1046_0.ja:
＊ んで　そのあと　きゅうに
　 ぐあい　わるくなって
　 うちに　かえったんだよね～

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1048_0.en:
* So, like, anyway...
* Kris, are you busy?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1048_0.ja:
＊ ところでさ…
＊ クリス　いまヒマ？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1053_0.en: * Aww, that's no way to talk to your almost-sister-in-law.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1053_0.ja:
＊ え～　もうすぐ　ぎりの
　 おねえちゃんに　なるのに
　 そんないいかた　ヒド～い。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1054_0.en:
* Nah, I'm joking.
* But, like...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1054_0.ja:
＊ な～んつって　ウソウソ。
＊ でもさ…　おぼえてる…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1055_0.en: * Remember that time I played truth or dare with Azzy?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1055_0.ja:
＊ あたしと　アズにゃんが
　 「王さまゲーム」
　 したときのこと～

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1056_0.en: * I, like, made him give me his first kiss...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1056_0.ja:
＊ そんとき　あたし
　 アズにゃんの　ファースト
　 キス　もらっちゃって～…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1057_0.en: * Then your mom found out he kissed someone, and...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1057_0.ja:
＊ んで　クリリぃのママ
　 アズにゃんが　よそのコと
　 キスしたって　しって～…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1058_0.en: * Like, I think she basically dialed 911.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1058_0.ja:
＊ ガチで　きゅうきゅうしゃ
　 よびそうな　いきおいで
　 パニクッて～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1059_0.en: * I swear your family went to church, like...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1059_0.ja:
＊ あのあと　クリリぃたち
　 かぞくぜんいんで…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1060_0.en: * Every single day that week.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1060_0.ja:
＊ いっしゅうかん　まいにち
　 きょうかいに　かよった
　 でしょ～？　ウケる～！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1064_0.en: * Aw, Krissy, you just wanted to say hi?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1064_0.ja:
＊ な～んだ～
　 あいさつ　しにきただけ～？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1065_0.en:
* That's adorable...
* Now get out of here.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1065_0.ja:
＊ も～　か～わ～い～い～
＊ じゃ　とっとと　かえんな。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1075_0.ja: ＊ …チュートリアル…買わないか？

＊ じゃあ　さっそくカネを…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1101_0.ja:

* You're just like us.

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1102_0.ja:

＊ 困ったときは　お互いさまだ…
　 ここはひとつ　助け合わねえとな。

* HA! HA! Did I say FIFTY!?

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1111_0.ja:

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1176_0.ja:

　 持ってねえのか！？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1188_0.ja:
＊ あのー　すみません。

　 ボク　持ってます…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1192_0.ja:

　 ついてきな　ジェントルナーさんよ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1207_0.en:
* I'm TP Master.
* Ask me about TP's.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1207_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　TPマスター。
＊ TPのことなら　なんでも聞いて。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.en:
* TP? What's TP?
* That's what lets you cast SPELLS, see!?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1215_0.ja:
＊ TP？　ってなぁにィ？
＊ 必要なんだよ
　 「まほう」使うのにィ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.en:
* When you see that orange bar,
* Cast some SPELLS when it's filled up far.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1216_0.ja:
＊ 見えるだろ　オレンジのメータァー。
＊ 「まほう」使えよ
　 上まで　たまったらァ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1217_0.en:
* TP...! It's quite a caper!
* TP! Stands for...
* ... Toilet Paper!
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1217_0.ja:
＊ TP！　ってなぁにィ？
＊ TP！　
　 「トイレットペーパー」って意味ィ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1219_0.en: * ... no, it stands for Tension Points.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1219_0.ja:
＊ …じゃなくて
　 「テンションポイント」の
　 略です。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1221_0.ja: ＊ えええぇ！　そうなの！？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.en:
* TP only lasts, inside a fight.
* Once you win, it's out of sight.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1225_0.ja:
＊ TP！　バトル終わると
　 もどるよ　ゼロ！
＊ バトル勝ったら　消えるよ　ドロン！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0.en:
* Having extra, feels unbearable.
* No point in saving, it's straight-up terrible.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1226_0.ja:
＊ 余分に　あっても「だからなにィ？」
＊ 使わずためても　意味ないしィ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1228_0.en: * But leftover TP turns into extra money at the end of battle...
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1228_0.ja:
＊ でも　TPが残っている状態で
　 バトルを終えると　おカネを
　 多くもらえますよ…？

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1230_0.en: * You mean I only should have been using one square!?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1230_0.ja:
＊ ええぇ！　だったら
　 １回に使うのは　10センチまでに
　 しとけば　よかったよーーー！！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.en:
* You get TP when you DEFEND.
* Protect yourself, then cast SPELLs, friend.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1234_0.ja:
＊ 「ぼうぎょ」をすると　TPたまるゥ。
＊ まず身を守れば「まほう」使えるゥ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.en: * You also get TP by getting close to bullets.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1235_0.ja:
＊ 敵弾　ギリで　かわしても
　 TPたまるゥ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1236_0.en: * Look for the heart outline when you get close to bullets.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1236_0.ja:
＊ 敵弾　近づき　ハートの外側
　 枠が見えたら　TPたまるゥ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1238_0.ja:
＊ 「TPたまる」って
　 ２回言ったな。
　 ショボいリリックだぜ。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1240_0.ja:
＊ だ…大事なことだから
　 ２回言ったんだよぅ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1245_0.ja:
＊ 「TPたまる」って
　 ２回言いましたね…
　 イマイチなリリックです…

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1256_0.en:
* I'm Ralsei Master.
* Ask me about RALSEI's.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1256_0.ja:
＊ ボクは　ラルセイ・マスター。
＊ ラルセイのことなら
　 なんでも聞いて。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1264_0.en:
* Ralsei's spell's called PACIFY.
* Use it on BABIES, before they CRY.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1264_0.ja:
＊ 「スリープ」。
　 それは　ラルセイの「まほう」ゥ！
　 電源おとさず　パソコン消せるゥ！

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1266_0.en: * What? It safely removes a "TIRED" enemy from combat.
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1266_0.ja:
＊ 違います…
　 「くたびれ」状態の敵を
　 倒さずに　逃がすんです。

scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1268_0.en: * What if you're fighting a BABY!?
scr_text_slash_scr_text_gml_1268_0.ja:
＊ で…でも！
　 パソコンと戦うことが
　 あるかもしれないでしょ！？
